					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[The side effects of work from home culture]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/the-side-effects-of-working-from-home/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 10 Sep 2020 18:55:43 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=522</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With the outbreak of the Corona Virus, many companies opted for 'Work From Home' as a solution for their work progress. To be a successful remote worker, one must have relentless perseverance and dedication towards work. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Shifting from the traditional office to remote working is not an easy transformation. It involves a lot of challenges and adaptation skills to completely get on with a new environment. Though, remote working is safe for the current conditions of the COVID 19 pandemic; 'work from home' has its own darker side as well.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Impediments caused by remote working</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Seating arrangement:</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The primary thing that you need, in order to focus on your work, is a proper work environment. An employee with a middle-class background can't easily afford a seating arrangement that could match his workplace seating.   <br> At the least, you need a desk where you can place your laptop and an office chair to start working at home.  Many people suffer from the lack of a desk at home and are have no option but to work hunched over coffee tables or on kitchen stools  This would, in turn, affect the employee's health and they may suffer from serious musculoskeletal conditions in the long run. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Lack of exercise</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Remote working is going to drive you insane by locking you within the boundary of four walls. The only possible exercise for a busy worker who sits all day long in front of the monitor is his travel from home to his office. Remote working takes away the prospect of this exercise as well. Employees would literally become immobile with their eyes continuously gazing on the screens for hours.  This will indeed pose a serious threat to their vision.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Network access</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This is one of the greatest tech headaches of working from home. Not all employees can afford wifi routers in their homes. Most of them will have to depend on the mobile internet, which would generally not last longer than a couple of continuous hours. The common issue faced is that the network signal would slow down to almost non-existent; you'll have to install all the new software tools in your PC which are confusing and your computer mouse would seem to be a piece of junk. Without an I.T. based system admin, you are now left on your own with your system's technical problems. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Time management</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Your home can never match your office. Working from home involves a lot of personal interruptions that would easily distract your focus from work. Basically you'll end up starting your work in the early morning with a view of finishing it soon; but unfortunately, end-up working till late hours.  <br> When you have an office routine, it's easier to leave what you do at the workplace and resume it the next day. When you work from home, your office is where you live. So you often end up working without a break. More working hours with less outcome is generally the possible result of remote working. This is because you don't strictly adhere to the timings when you are at home. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Frustrating virtual meets</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Even though we have technologies like  Google Meet, MS Teams, Cisco Webex, Zoom, GoToMeeting, Google Hangouts that facilitate us to conduct online conferences; their efficiency is significantly less than face to face meetings. Interrupted network connectivity, lack of eye contact, and technical dependencies tend to hinder the potential outcome of the meet.  <br> Organizing even a small group of people for an online conclave requires the attendees to be familiar with the software that's used to host the meeting. Facial expressions and body language reveal more details than the actual words. In the case of the virtual meet, these cues are either not notified or hidden. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For instance, When you have to discuss an architectural plan with your client, it is best to do so over a table. You won't be able to explain with the same efficiency when it comes to an online conference.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Lack of physical interaction</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For an organization that functions with multiple departments, an employee in a particular department may get his related doubts instantly clarified from a member of any other department. For example, a project manager working in the engineer's cell can enter the drafting section and get the relevant details that he needs.  Thereby, he can come over and resume his work with ease. This kind of immediate 'interaction and response process' is a major absence while working from home. This is because there is no fixed 'common availability' of workers. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Each employee works at different hours based on his own lifestyle. The person you are looking for may not be available when you need them the most. Though you have multiple options like Video calls, texts, IM, etc; they don’t make a difference if the damn person isn’t there on the other end. This kind of lack of community and differences in culture is the major drawback of remote working</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Besides all these, ' Work From Home' is extremely unreliable with no proper supervision of activities because a manager is not physically present to monitor your work progress. Moreover, team spirit is something that could only be achieved when employees work as a team; in real. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To sum up, one must never mix family and work together. Remote working emphasizes balancing family with the job; which indeed is not that easy. Managing both under a single roof would definitely affect the individual's internal peace and would result in decreased work productivity. Though 'work from home' can be an effective temporary solution at times of emergency or pandemic; it cannot prove to be sustainable in the long run. You'll eventually have to restore back to normal ensuring that you take all safety measures and precautions. Onfra would be of great help to take of your visitors and clients at the reception. To sign up <a href="https://app.onfra.io/login?utm_source=darker_side_of_wfh&amp;utm_media=article&amp;utm_campaign=blog">click here</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Best practices for Visitor management]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/best-practices-for-visitor-management/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 24 Sep 2020 14:07:17 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=537</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Though the Visitor management solutions  facilitate contact-less visitor check-in and instant notification to ensure safety during Covid 19, an online software alone is just not sufficient for an organized workplace. We bring to you, some of the best practices for effective Visitor management that would help you make your enterprise compete with the  leading organizations.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Security- The Prime necessity!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> Having a vigorous organizational security framework is inevitably essential for  meeting the global business standards.  Its necessary to safeguard your company's intellectual property and confidential data from  unauthorized third parties.  </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You'll have to ensure that you prevent data breach in your Enterprise.  <br>In IBM’s Security Services 2014 Cyber Security Intelligence Index, which has analyzed cyber-attack and incident data, it is to be noted that more than 95% of all incidents cited “human error” as a contributing factor to the attack. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Teach proper data disposal techniques to your employees, in order &nbsp;to minimize the risk of leaking data into  wrong hands. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>  Constantly update your products  to ensure that your devices are secure for use  and that the vulnerabilities do not affect the business functions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>  Moreover audit your organization in regular intervals to be cautious of possible data breaches.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Create a seamless visitor experience</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> Many organizations focus on creating a welcoming reception area, but forget to consider the main building reception experience.  It's more important to focus on making the visitors' path clear. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> You can facilitate easy navigation by placing sign boards and way finders; thereby preventing the visitors from getting confused. Moreover, the visitors would not have the need  to keep pestering the receptionist to find a way to their respective room.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Finally, the most important segment is to improvise your waiting area. Your visitors/guests should not feel uncomfortable when they  wait for long hours. Therefore, make the waiting room as appealing and comfy as possible.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> Improve the seating arrangements; attach an air conditioner, if you can afford one and don't forget to provide refreshments and magazines. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Prepare prior to their visit</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This is one of the major etiquette followed in many international software companies. If your guest happens to be someone you have been awaiting for a long period, and finally got a chance to invite; then you certainly have to make necessary arrangements prior to their visit. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Send them a warm invitation with all necessary information such as (the date, time, your office location, floor of the cabin  and the list of planned events).</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Arrange coffee or lunch for the invitee. A VIP generally wouldn't be comfortable if you ask them to wait for a lunch. You'll have to keep everything ready.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Make sure that all the audio/video equipment are in proper working condition which the guest may probably be using.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>If they happen to be a really important person, you can even arrange travel facilities to and from your workplace.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Last but not the least, equip your organization with Online Visitor management Software to promote digital check in, delivery, watchlist and a number of other features. To sign up Onfra for a seamless experience, <a href="https://app.onfra.io/signup/?utm_source=best_practices&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=ccmc">click here</a>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Equip your organization with fire safety measures]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/fire-safety/</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2020 18:12:59 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=555</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>One of the frequent mishaps that could occur in multi storied enterprises are fire accidents. These fire accidents influence the possibility of theft, physical injuries, burns and loss of intellectual or materialistic property. Workers and employees are the greatest treasure of every organization. Their lives and safety matter the most. It is necessary to keep your workplace well prepared and equipped to face such consequences without panic.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As an organization's boss it is your duty to ensure that necessary safety precautions are taken well in advance. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Fire protection tools:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Fire extinguisher:</strong>                                                                                                        Make sure that each floor of your building has a fire extinguisher on either sides of stairs. Also, learn and train your staffs to use a fire extinguisher</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Water sprinklers and Smoke detectors:</strong>                                                       Equip water sprinklers in the ceiling along the pathway to the lobby.  Never block sprinklers as it may affect their functionality which is  <br>primarily  based on sensors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Place  firefighting equipment at an easily accessible place, so that you don't waste time looking out for them during fire. Don't hinder the way to emergency exits by stacking up goods.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Evacuation chairs:                                                                                             </strong> </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Evacuation chairs enable safe evacuation of those with mobility difficulties during an emergency; thereby allowing them to tackle corridors and stairs with ease.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Fire exit equipment:                                                                                                                   </strong></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You can equip your organization with tools like panic bars, emergency push pads, escape ladders etc.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong> Exit sign boards</strong>:                                                                                              Emergency lighting, illuminated exit signs, boards with fire safety  signs, ID and action signs should be placed at appropriate places.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong> Escape hoods and masks:  </strong><br>These safety gears shall help you to safely escape in case of a fire. It gives you nearly 15 minutes to flee through potentially toxic gases. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Safety measures:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Always keep in mind that "Prevention is better than cure". You may follow the steps  recommended  below to prevent a fire outbreak in your valuable workplace.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Train and educate the staffs and workers how to react during a sudden fire. You may also have a mock session to help them get an idea of how to face fire accidents.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Keep all the above mentioned tools in accessible reach to benefit from their functionality. The safety tools have to be placed essentially where inflammable products are stocked.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> Moreover, store  chemicals and flammable substances that your company needs in a dry, secure closet or room that has adequate ventilation.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Smoking should be strictly prohibited within the complex. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>  Inspect every minute electrical hazard as mostly fires are caused due to faulty wiring and malfunctioning of electrical gadgets.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Last but foremost, maintenance is the prime necessity to protect yourself from such unhappy incidents. Check whether your electric lines and fire safety tools like sensors and alarms are in proper working condition  once in every couple of months. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How to behave during a fire breakout?</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Once you hear the ring of the fire alarm, start moving towards the exit at the closest proximity to you. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Stay calm and don't rush along the way.  Activate the fire alarm if you were the first to detect the fire outbreak. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Dial 911 to seek emergency assistance if needed. Follow the sign boards and reach the exit point. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>You may use the emergency equipment such as fire extinguishers  if you know how to use them properly . </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> Never use elevators during a fire accident; prefer using staircase. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Before you open a closed door, ensure that the handles are not hot. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>In case of dense smoke, try to stay low and wear hoods and masks to protect yourself. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>If you're helplessly trapped, don't lose hope. Wait for the firemen to arrive and rescue you. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Stay positive no matter what is happening around you and the Almighty will definitely show a safe way out for you.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Design a secure lobby for your workplace]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/designing-secure-lobby/</link>
		<pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2020 07:54:01 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=558</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Your company's lobby is the portal between your organization's public and private zone.  Here public zone refers to the parking lot or the area surrounding your building whereas private zone is the environment inside your premises where you allow your employees, staff and invited visitors. The intermediate portal- 'Lobby' is basically the entry point  to your office. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Designing a lobby with enhanced security measures would allow you to properly control access into the building eliminating the need for additional security measures to be provided at the interior. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>While many lobbies are designed to appear aesthetically beautiful, many fail to meet the essential security standards. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Designing a secure lobby:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Transparent glass doors:                                           </h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The receptionist should be able to completely view the people who are going to enter the building so that she could be well prepared in advance to greet the incoming visitor  and to register the check in process.  Moreover, the receptionist would be able to monitor strangers or suspicious individuals present outside the entrance. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Barrier to the interior</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Separate the reception desk  from the interior private space of the employees by means of a physical barrier. This would prevent the unauthorized visitors from sneaking or roaming into the private segment of the workplace. Physical barriers separating each cabin would be advisable to keep discussions within boundaries. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Block the alternate ways</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>While designing a workplace ensure that the reception desk is situated ahead of stairs and elevators. If not, the visitors may skip the check-in registration process and gain access inside your premises. If there are staircase and elevators ahead of your lobby, block their access or ensure that the access is restricted only to authenticated staffs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Multiple Reception Desks</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Having separate lobby for employees and visitors would help to organize the check in process more easily. This would eradicate the delay that an employee might face due to overcrowding of visitors.  Moreover, each receptionist can focus entirely on a single mode of check in. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Go for a virtual receptionist!</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Your reception desk is the first phase of safety defense. You no longer have to rely on receptionist and clerks to manage your company's check in process. You can opt for virtual visitor management application- Onfra to replace the traditional practice of log books and signing sheets. With Onfra's Qr check in, OTP verification and safe maintenance of collected details your database will remain safe and secured. Onfra is a feature-loaded smart visitor management system that would certainly give you the best seamless experience managing your workplace. To sign up Onfra, <a href="https://app.onfra.io/signup/?utm_source=design_lobby&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=ccma">click here</a></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Enforcing visitor policy in your workplace]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/workplace-visitor-policy/</link>
		<pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2020 01:58:24 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=564</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> While many organizations concentrate on improving the company's security standards, most fail to enforce a strong policy drafted specifically for visitors. This would not only protect your workplace, but also serves as a mutual agreement between the enterprise and the visitors. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Significance of having a Visitor policy</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Well... These policies are helpful in securing your office from potential risk of visitors and strangers sneaking into your organization. A well-planned visitor policy aims at preventing physical and intellectual theft of your the workplace resources, intended or negligent accidents,  terrorism etc. The essence of the policy depends upon your organization's value and size.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Key features that your Visitor policy should focus on:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>The visitor policy must specify the ones who are responsible for organizing the visitor permissions and access.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>It should insist the visitors to sign in by feeding their details, identity verification and OTP confirmation.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>It should permit each visitor only after he/she has obtained the token/visitor badge with the unique visitor id.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>The policy must also define the visiting hours and the instances when the restrictions have to be strengthened.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>It shall also list the devices and gadgets that are prohibited inside the premises. ( For example, you may implement strict measures to block visitors from bringing in smart phones, cameras and other electronic devices)</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> Your visitor policy should mention the accessible boundaries for each category of visitors. The various criteria of visitors may include temporary workers, former employees, friends and family members of current workers, vendors, interviewees etc.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li> It shall also grant special privileges for the employees' registered family members and friends. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>The policy must also state the disciplinary action that has to be taken on suspicious visitors who are found breaking the contract.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>While these Visitor policies would safeguard your office from intended and unintended harm, you have to ensure that it doesn't irritate the legal visitors. It is your responsibility to make them feel warm and welcome.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For the best visitor management experience sign in to<a href="https://app.onfra.io/signup/?utm_source=visitorPolicy&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=ccma"> Onfra</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To read our article on Onfra's NDA feature <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/nda-sign-in-made-easy/">click here</a></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[5 Ways to build an eco-conscious workplace]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/5-ways-to-build-an-eco-conscious-workplace/</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 26 Jan 2021 20:00:53 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=633</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Have you ever wondered India's ranking in terms of sustainability? Despite being the world's largest democracy with rich culture and heritage, it is shameful to know that India ranks 168 out of 180 countries in terms of its  <br>Environment Performance Index in 2020! India scored below the regional average score on all five key parameters. (like environmental health, including air quality, sanitation and drinking water, heavy metals and waste management) . Why do we lag way far behind the other nations?</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Well...Perhaps it's high time that we plan for the long-term preservation of environment in a developing India, while simultaneously improving efficiency of resource-use. Instead, we are caught in an environment vs development crossfire. It’s time for a real attempt at balance. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With a view of marching towards a cleaner and greener India, we've  to start from the grass root level. Since we spend one-third of our life at work, it is ideal to begin redesigning our workplace to be more environment friendly. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Ideas to design an eco-conscious office:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Save energy! Save cost!</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As we know the majority of companies in India are IT based. Switching off  lights, air conditioners and other electronic gadgets when not in use will help you save a lot of energy consumption and hence cut down your office electricity bill. By shutting the computers down at the end of every working day, you can save about $230 per month for one room of about 35 to 40 computers. Also, Close the washbasin taps in your workplace not only when you use it but also when your colleagues leave it open.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Segregate and recycle!</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Segregate the waste generated in your office into bio degradable and non bio degradable waste by collecting them in separate bins.  You must be aware that Companies like Starbucks have prevented the use of plastic straws. Similarly, take measures to reduce the use of toxic products that could be harmful to the environment. You can direct the e waste produced from your company to recycle centers instead of disposing in landfills</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You must be aware of how Croma conducts e-ware and plants samplings in the name of every donor. Similarly, You may also  encourage your employees to donate old electronics. As a token of appreciation, you can provide them with gift cards/vouchers at the year end. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Designing a green Workplace</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For ages, the word 'design'  has always directed our thoughts about artificial decorations and arrangements. How about going green with your design? Sounds interesting right? Well... You can adorn your workplace interior with lush green indoor plants. It'll create a peaceful and serene atmosphere that would be refreshing and healthy for the employees. Also, surround your campus with green trees and shrubs that'll help increase oxygen level.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Support for common transportation</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>If possible, arrange for a common company van for your employees. Just imagine, how much pollution you would be able to control if all the employees reach office via a single vehicle rather than each driving their individual automobile.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Reduce the amount of paper usage</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With technological advancements such as cloud computing and large memory storage devices, we can easily minimize the dependency on trees for papers. If you aren't capable of growing a tree, you can atleast try to restrain yourself from cutting one. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Implementing eco conscious practices in the workplace will help employees feel healthier, peaceful and more satisfied with your company. It'll boost them with the energy to work responsibly. Let's take the first step of creating an environment friendly workplace marching towards a greener global community!</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

		<title><![CDATA[Perks of being a professional Receptionist]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/perks-of-being-a-professional-receptionist/</link>
		<pubDate>Mon, 01 Feb 2021 20:16:51 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=639</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For ages, the job of a receptionist  has been under-estimated. Graduates feel embarrassed to  take up this profession as their career. If you're an individual looking for a non-monotonous environment to work in, with  proficiency in communication, technical knowledge, managing and assisting skills; then applying for the job of a receptionist, is something you shouldn't miss trying out. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">You'll be fairly rewarded:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You might think that a receptionist would barely earn. It is true that the initial remuneration could be less. However, with years of experience, your income will get incremented significantly. You would be surprised to know that the average pay of a receptionist is about $35,000 per annum. The payment also varies  based on the sector you're working in. While a hotel receptionist can earn upto $20,000 per year, the one working in a hospital can earn  nearly $30,000 per year and a corporate receptionist can earn as much as  $40,000 per year. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Receptionist- the Representor!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Receptionist  often serve as the company's representor. They're the ones who keep everything ticking over. The front desk executive is the first member that the visitor focuses on while entering the company. The more professional they look,  better will be the the opinion the visitors build about the organization. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Possessing Versatile skills:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Being an efficient receptionist requires one to master a wide variety of skills like the ability to comprehend and assist the needs of visitors, the command to manage and organize the  serenity of the lobby and good computer knowledge to quickly generate invoice/ to pull out the required details.  So, if you've got these skills handy then it would definitely be the right job you're looking for.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">A wide opportunity for receptionist to march ahead!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Working as a receptionist will shape you up in many different aspects. This will also make you befitting to different kind of jobs. Good conduct and years of experience will elevate your post from a receptionist to a hotel manager. However, it is not that easy to get placed as a receptionist of a big company. They look for individuals with the right combination of the required skills and qualifications.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To upgrade your organization with a digital receptionist, visit <a href="https://onfra.io/">https://onfra.io/ </a></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Work desk practices- Why should you have a clutter-less work desk?]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/why-should-you-have-a-clutter-less-work-desk/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 11 Feb 2021 18:03:52 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=647</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Happy employees make successful companies! Being happy will make them more energetic, concentrated and productive.  To create a cool and peaceful working environment, it's better to start with aligning the work desk. Keeping your desk tidy will provide you with various advantages. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Avoids distraction:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Having an untidy, clumsy work-desk will distract workers' attention from what they must focus. Place only the essential items on top of the desk. Remove the unnecessary components so that your mind doesn't wander around. Organizing the desk with the required files and resources at the end of the day, will help you work more efficiently the next day. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Helps you to Plan and organize:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Equipping your desk with Sticky-notes, business cards and to-do list assists you in planning your daily tasks. Always remember that an hour of planning can save ten hours of working. Plan in advance, the previous night and list down your task in the order of priorities. This enables you to perform the highly important jobs first and then concentrate on the second degree tasks. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Good work desk gives you a feel of completion:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Beginning a day with the tasks of the previous day, keeps your mind occupied and pressurizes you with uncompleted work load. This indeed will not let you concentrate on your next set of work set. There comes the benefit of keeping your desk neat and tidy. Lesser the number of components on the table, healthier will be the employee's thoughts and action.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"> <br>Raises prominence</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> Arranging your desk neatly, makes you look punctual, skilled, thorough, and organized. This also helps you stand out from the rest of your co-workers.  We lose precious minutes of work every time we go searching for a lost paper/file on a cluttered desk.&nbsp; Therefore, having an orderly arranged desk can help you be prompt in fetching the required documents on time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Instills a sense of peace and calmness!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>We may assume that we aren't bothered by the overstuffed file racks or the stacks of paper on desk. However the truth is that constant visual reminders of disorganization drain our cognitive resources and reduce our ability to focus.  Research claims that stress and emotional exhaustion causes workers to delay making decisions and to keep more material for all their ongoing tasks within easy reach </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="1-bring-in-natural-lighting-to-the-work-environment">Support your work desk with natural lighting!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Apart from having a neat and organized desk, proper lighting is that which adds the finishing touch to your organization's interior. Light is the most important synchronizing agent for the brain and body. Employees with good light exposure at the office had longer sleep duration, better sleep quality, more physical activity and better quality of life compared to the ones with less light exposure in the workplace. A clean desk breeds positivity, encouragement, and opens up endless possibilities for its employees </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To read an article on eco-friendly practices to organize your workplace, visit:  <br><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/5-ways-to-build-an-eco-conscious-workplace/">https://onfra.io/5-ways-to-build-an-eco-conscious-workplace/</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[5 organizational threats every Employee should be ready to face in 2021]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/5-organizational-threat-every-employee-should-be-ready-to-face-in-2021/</link>
		<pubDate>Sat, 13 Feb 2021 19:48:38 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=657</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Threats to an organization are numerous; and they're certainly ineluctable. However, an efficient enterprise is that which not only focuses on its progress but also concentrates equally on safeguarding the company against the various threat(s) it may be subjected to.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Threat to the workers' well being:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The outbreak of the fatal Corona Virus shook the whole world, upending working life  transforming how and where people do their jobs. Offices can no longer think of neglecting safety precautions as they've become the need of the era. The dreadful Covid 19 has emphasized the significance of adopting healthy safe practices to avoid threat to the employee's health. Social distancing, online reception management applications, sanitizers, face masks, touchless verification and virtual meets have thus become indispensable . </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Threat to an organization's Intellectual property theft</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Robbery of an organization's ideas and inventions is one of the most fearful threats a company can encounter. Intellectual property theft includes the theft of trade secrets, confidential information, proprietary products and documents. Therefore, to avoid becoming a prey to such theft, companies ought to protect their business interests by implementing meaningful data security policies and infrastructure. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Risk of cyber attack</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Cybercrime is one of the most common form of threat to any firm. With the growing demand for digital operations due to the impact of pandemic, the risk of cyber attacks is also rising to a great extent. Necessary security measures have to be employed to protect your company's valuable data from the hands of hackers and thwarters. Signing of Non disclosure agreements, data encryption, password integrity and Invention Disclosure Records  can help you in safeguarding yourselves from cyber crimes.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Brand and reputation crisis</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> From abusive comments/reviews to sensitive data breaches, the way you tackle a potential crisis decides whether you're gonna retain your customers or let them move on to a competitor. It may take plenty of years to build a company's reputation in the society; but barely few minutes to destroy the name. During a reputation crisis, we must welcome constructive criticism from people and take public feedback into account.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Problems associated with Supply chain</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> A deep study on how global producers manage the disruptions to their supply chains will aid companies to frame their responses. The disruptions in the supply chain management affects the productivity of various companies to a great extent. For instance, the cost to import products from China may rise to peak in the near future. Farmers are also facing a severe blow from the Central Government. This will negatively impact a number of industries related to  food processing; thereby affecting the smooth functioning of the supply chain. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In order to overcome this, the Government of India should encourage native farmers, businessmen and cottage industries to produce resources from within our nation. This will help to meet the needs of every company in the country. Companies can also work on adopting alternative sources to supplement their supply. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:quote -->
<blockquote class="wp-block-quote"><!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Despite all these threats, offices ought to function effectively; but just not the same way as it was. We've got to adapt to the new reality ensuring both safety and efficacy. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Plants that'll impel you to work!]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/plants-thatll-impel-you-to-work/</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 16 Feb 2021 14:35:59 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=661</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Getting along with work flow isn't a piece of cake for many. Remaining seated at your office desk from dawn to dusk can drive you crazy, especially if you're an outdoor lover. If there's something you could control about your workplace environment, it's how your work desk makes you feel. Sufficient natural lighting and indoor plants help you breathe fresh air and improves your degree of concentration.  Here we've suggested few plants that'll suit best at desk. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Cactus:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This would be the best pick if  your work desk is supported with adequate natural illumination. This is because, being a desert plant, cactus requires a lot of direct sunlight to sustain. However it is least care-seeking and doesn't demand prompt watering everyday. It needs to be watered just once in every 4-7 days. The only thing to be careful with cactus, is to make sure you don't end up pricking your finger with its thorns. Place the cactus plants in a safe corner out of instant reach.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Devil's ivy:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With plenty of trailing leafy growth saturated with splashes of color, <strong>Devil's ivy</strong> is the ideal <strong>indoor</strong> plant. Indirect sunlight and monthly plant food are enough for it to thrive. Coming in different colors and shapes, it adapts well to different levels of lighting; thereby thriving as the most versatile and easy to grow indoor plant for your office cabin. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Bamboo:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Requiring minimal sunlight and self watering pots, bamboo is also a great choice for your workplace. Just ensure you replace the water every once in a while. Keep them in a pot away from air conditioners or heaters. Good drainage with pebble based pots can help them grow well. Some even believe that growing bamboo plants can bring good&nbsp;luck, wealth and fortune. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Bromeliads:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Bromeliad would be a good choice if you opt for an ornamental flowering plant. With its rigid fleshy leaves and colorful petals, it can liven up a dull desk when kept in the right place. However, they require  <br> comparatively more  maintenance during the initial stages. In the later stages, all they need is sufficient care and occasional watering. They generally require more humidity and can &nbsp;thrive in bright, indirect sunlight or patch of shade</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"> <br><strong>Snake plants:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> Scientifically called Sansevieria, the snake plant is  a beautiful green friend, that is known for removing pollutants from the air and increasing the oxygen content. It requires almost no sunlight but can also tolerate direct sunlight. It is advisable to place the snake plant in a warm corner of your desk having temperature greater than 10 degree Celsius.  It acts as an excellent air purifier and can be ideal for irregular care-takers. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Oxalis:</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Not only are they available in variety of sizes and colors, but they're also prolific. Also termed as shamrock , they have beautiful foliage and many delicate blossoms. They prefer part shade, well-drained soil that is moist, but not wet. Their leaves move in response to sunlight, opening in high ambient light and <strong>closing</strong> at low light levels.&nbsp; Having an oxalis plant would be a great addition to your work desk. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To read more about how to build an eco conscious workplace visit: <br><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/5-ways-to-build-an-eco-conscious-workplace/">https://onfra.io/5-ways-to-build-an-eco-conscious-workplace/</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Designing your Home-office post Covid-19]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/designing-your-home-office-post-covid-19/</link>
		<pubDate>Sat, 20 Feb 2021 11:50:27 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=670</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The Covid-19 pandemic shook the entire world lightening up the requirement of an office arrangement at every home.  <br>Adapting to work in the home environment wasn't such an easy task for many. Work From Home will be more productive if your mind is able to psychologically associate your home with your office atmosphere. In order to achieve successful remote working, we need to evolve our home-office continuously into what a perfect workplace looks and feels like. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Work desk - the primary constituent of your home-office! </strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The first step towards setting up your home office is to arrange for a proper desk  &amp; chair that is comfortable enough to place your laptop, files and other essentials. Do not overcrowd your desk with things that tend to distract your focus from work. The more spacious and tidy your desk looks, the more soothing will be your frame of mind. Keep your desk simple, yet satisfying. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Choose your colors wisely! </strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Your home-office set-up must be aesthetically pleasing to look at. Choosing the right combination of colors can help in achieving a pleasant workplace ambience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p> <br>The all-white home office has a certain cultured and systemized charm about it. It will allow you to add brightly colored decors and accessories in a much elegant way. A good way to add splashes of bright colors is to pick two or three colors that you wanna add. Once you've decided on your favorite accent colors, you can use everything ranging from the area rug and drapes to the ceiling and chairs having the shades of those chosen colors. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Err on the safer side</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>If your home-office is to be visited by your clients/colleagues, ensure that you follow sufficient measures to strengthen the safety standards. Therefore you can arrange for a custom table near the entrance with sanitizers, masks and temperature sensors. Further, you may opt for a digital visitor management software like <a href="https://onfra.io/?utm_source=redesign-home-office&amp;utm_medium=article&amp;utm_campaign=ccma">Onfra</a>, that'll help you in contact-less management of visitors. Anti microbial furniture collections are also preferable to avoid the residence of harmful viruses on the surface of desk and other furnishings.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Keep it natural!</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To help you keep energized throughout your remote working experience, you need enough natural lighting and cross ventilation. Adding lush green air purifying plants on your desk might be the missing nature's link you might be searching for. You can also have an alternate work desk out in the open space; such as in your terrace, lawn, your home garden or balcony. This gives you the luxury to enjoy fresh air, energizing sunlight, green surroundings with soothing distractions like the chirping of birds and the rhythm of the cool breeze. Having multiple office set-ups within your house can help you get rid of stress and monotony. Make sure that your alternate work desk has the same theme as your primary desk. This gives you a consistent feeling that doesn't shift you away from your work mode. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Garnish your office desk with essentials</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Being seated on the executive chair with the glazing wooden desk having table lamp, sticky notes, acrylic organizer set,  desk calendars etc. might be a dream for many. Who is gonna stop you from having your own executive desk at home? You can have your own office set-up the way you've ever been dreaming. Equip your desk with all necessary <a href="https://www.pinterest.com/habytlifestyle/desk-accessories/">accessories</a> and tools that'll add meaning to your home-office. Your desk tells you that you're ready to work and makes you feel empowered. The more professional your design is, the more involved you'll be with your work.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To read an article on plants that'll impel you to work,<a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/plants-thatll-impel-you-to-work/"> click here</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<p>While managing visitors is one of the most challenging tasks of the post-pandemic scenario, many companies worldwide have opted for a contact less digital solution. Onfra is an efficient visitor management solution that has a number of premium features in store including Instant notifications, watchlist, NDA sign in, Deliveries, contact-less check-in, OTP verification, custom badges and a lot more. You can have a trial session with the basic plan completely free of cost and choose from the various packages offered. To make the best use of the software’s available features, all you need are a few primary hardware and software requirements before logging into Onfra.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Onfra's Minimum hardware and software requirements:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#PC">PC</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#TABLET">TABLET</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#WEB-CAMERA">WEB CAMERA</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#PRINTER">PRINTER</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#GOOGLE CHROME">GOOGLE CHROME</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#STABLE-INTERNET-CONNECTIVITY">STABLE INTERNET CONNECTIVITY</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#WIFI-ROUTER">WIFI ROUTER</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="#VISITDESK-PAD-AND-VISITDESK-HOST-APP">ONFRA SOFTWARE</a></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="PC"><strong>PC:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The very first essential for the smooth functioning of your Visitor Management Software is to have a stable PC. Computer is the crucial and elemental component of a digital receptionist by which you can validate the entry of your company’s visitors. This would be the device with which the visitors will directly interact for their check in and check out process. The admin can also control and configure the settings of Onfra via a PC acting as the central repository. Your computer’s screen size can be as large as 10 inches, so that it’ll be fairly visible to the visitors.<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="TABLET"><strong>Tablet:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>You may also use tablets or iPads in place of PC’s. Presently, tablets are more common in use than traditional computers as they’re more handy. Onfra is compatible with both Apple’s IOS and Google’s Android. While Apple iPads are professional and more secure, Android tablets are affordable and have an easy to use interface. While PC’s are more preferable for admin use, tablets/iPads are much more suitable to be used as check-in kiosk.<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="WEB-CAMERA"><strong>Web Camera:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To avail features such as&nbsp; check-in validation via photo capturing, scanning etc., you need to have a webcam with good resolution. If your desktop has an inbuilt camera, then you probably don't have to fetch a separate webcam unless the quality is really bad. If not, you need to go for a USB webcam.<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="PRINTER"><strong>Printers supported by Onfra:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra allows you to spot your visitors in a glimpse by printing visitor badges along with the visitor information. For this you’d need any WiFi enabled printer. Onfra allows printing of tokens via both android and mac supported devices. It also supports Apple Airprint that is compatible with over hundred printers. Along with the printer, you must also have sufficient paper bundles (PRINT ROLLS) of the desired size, opacity, thickness etc. to get your visitor badge printed.<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="GOOGLE-CHROME"><strong>Google Chrome:</strong><br></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Please ensure that you have Chrome browser installed on your PC. Further, using the upgraded version of the browser gives you a much smoother experience.<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="STABLE-INTERNET-CONNECTIVITY"><strong>Stable Internet Connectivity- The main essential for Onfra:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A stable internet connection is very vital and is the key necessity for the successful functioning of visitor management software. With good access to the internet, Onfra would be able to automate your entire workplace lobby like a pro.&nbsp;</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading" id="WIFI-ROUTER"><strong>Wifi Router:</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Modern wifi routers with dual or triband capabilities helps you deliver stronger wifi signals with better internet ranges. With enhanced firmware and network functionality, wifi routers is yet another essential component to fulfil your company’s digital receptionist setup.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong> Onfra Pad and Onfra Host app:</strong><br></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The two applications that make up Onfra - the Smart Visitor management software, are Onfra Pad and Onfra Host. While Onfra pad is an application that has to be equipped at every gate/entry point of your workplace for supporting hassle-free check-in of visitors; OnfraPad is the software that verifies and validates the visitors’ entry. You may now download this application from <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ifelsetech.visitdesk.pad&amp;hl=en_IN">Google Playstore</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra host is another application that works in conjunction with Onfra pad. This application is meant to be used by the host for managing requests and approvals. This can also be downloaded from <a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ifelsetech.visitdesk.host&amp;hl=en_US">Google Play store</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To view the 'Recommended requirements checklist' for tablet and PC setup</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Perks of Visitor management system over Visitor sign in sheets]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/perks-of-visitor-management-system-over-visitor-sign-in-sheets/</link>
		<pubDate>Fri, 06 Aug 2021 11:48:45 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=713</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Gone are days when enterprises had to keep track of their visitors by means of log book or check in sheets. Digitalization has advanced almost every aspect of human life striving to make tasks easier. It hasn't left any stone unturned and so is the process of visitor sign in. Using visitor management system, one can seamlessly monitor the check in details of visitors. Let's do a small comparison between Visitor management system and Visitor sign in sheets to prove this in a better manner. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Visitor sign in sheet Vs Visitor Management system</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Cost and efficiency:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Although a log book appears to be cost friendly in comparison to digital solutions, remember that you would have to pay a huge amount for the receptionist in addition to the cost of check in sheet. Remember your concerns to conserve forest resources? Logbooks, papers and forests...- hope you could relate.  Why cut trees when you can opt for an easier alternative?</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Moreover, smart visitor management systems such as Onfra charges a very minimal price that almost any company can afford. Going for a digital solution will not just help protect our environment but also eliminates chances of human error.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Security:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In what way do you think is a log book more secure? There are plenty of chances that the sign in sheets could be lost. Anybody can easily mess with the entries in the absence of the receptionist. There is no surety whether the person himself has made the entry or if somebody has impersonated. Besides the entire details in the log book is public and anybody who signs the sheet would be able to view the check in details of everyone else. What if a blacklisted person tries to enter the province? Would the log book be able to stop him? </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A visitor management system on the other hand is a lot more secure.  It thoroughly verifies a person's identity either by means of credentials, otp or QR code before issuing them the visitor pass. It collects the details of visitors such as name, mail id, check in and check out time along with their purpose of visit etc. This digital check in platform keeps track of new, recurring, invited and blacklisted visitors. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Therefore, visitor management system obviously outperforms sign in sheets  in terms of security. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Maintenance and reliability</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>How far do you think you can rely upon your receptionist? What if there's a sudden huge crowd? Would she handle every person's query single handedly? Will everyone be able to register their names? What if the receptionist has gone on a break or if she has taken a day off? Don't you think it would make the front desk a bit chaotic? Indeed. A receptionist can never be equally productive as a virtually aided kiosk. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Having Onfra visitor management application installed on your tablets/ iPad would be an effective replacement to the traditional receptionist. The visitors would no longer have to stand in long queues or wait for a single receptionist to respond. They can directly check in by feeding their respective credentials and get their pass printed in no time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>If at all, you like to have a receptionist you could hire one. As the visitor management takes care of the check in process, the receptionist can take up a better productive role, enhancing the visitor experience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"> Summary </h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To sum up, I would suggest with confidence that a Digital Visitor Management System such as Onfra is relatively a much reliable solution when compared to the traditional sign in sheets. What are you waiting for then? Get your smart visitor management solution now @<a href="https://app.onfra.io">Onfra</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Hybrid work - The future model]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/hybrid-work-the-future-model/</link>
		<pubDate>Wed, 18 Aug 2021 16:36:46 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=724</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Hybrid work is a kind of flexible workplace model that focuses on the welfare of both the employees as well as the organization. According to scientific research, humans are capable of performing with more efficiency when they're comfortable. With Hybrid work style, employees are either free to work from home or on site based on their preference. They also have the freedom to work on site for a part of the week and remotely work for the rest of the days. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why do you have to go for Hybrid Work?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Hybrid work can indeed be predicted as the future work style. Hybrid workforce brings a lot of benefits to the organization. A few among them are:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Increased efficiency</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With the onset of pandemic, many of us realized that remote working is not a myth; but is also an alternative way of working. However there are chances that it might make the employees feel lonely and depressed. They might miss the conference room meetings and panel discussions. To avoid such cases, you can go for Hybrid model where employees can either work from home or in person as per their preference. This flexibility will drive them to perform better and in turn result in increased productivity.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Well being of Employee</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>When you care for your employees' well being, they would in turn contribute better to your company's welfare. What you sow is what you reap. With a rigid frame and structure for your employees to follow, you wouldn't be able to  retain them for long. Employee satisfaction is a prime essential for an organization's success. With hybrid work model you will be able to achieve Employee satisfaction to a great extent in your enterprise.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Hybrid work- An Environment friendly model!</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With enforcement of hybrid work, employees need not visit their office everyday. Therefore the pollution that could be caused by the emission of poisonous gas from vehicles can be reduced to a great extent. This will indeed help our Mother Earth to undergo a greener transformation.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Beneficial at times of sickness</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With the current Covid 19 pandemic, we know that it is highly unsafe to mingle with the crowd despite the administration of vaccines due to the mutation of viruses. In such cases you might have to isolate yourself if you happen to notice any symptom. During the course of isolation, you can continue to focus on your professional work if your company has  embraced a hybrid work model.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Universal hiring</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With hybrid work, you can employ people from anywhere across the world. Even foreigners or people from other states who can visit your office only once in a while can be hired if their part of work doesn't demand physical presence. With a large set of people you can hire from, you have higher chances of tapping the highly ignited minds of the world into your company</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/5-organizational-threat-every-employee-should-be-ready-to-face-in-2021/">Click here</a> to read about the five organizational threats every employee should be ready to face in 2021</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

		<title><![CDATA[Employee Checkins and Contractor Checkins now available on Onfra!]]></title>

		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A cloud-based visitor management system called Onfra enables companies to effectively control the flow of customers, vendors, and staff on their property.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Do you struggle a lot to keep track of your employees and contractors as a business owner or manager? Do you frequently wonder who is still on the job site and who has left for the day? You can now track employee and contractor check-ins on Onfra, so you don't have to worry.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Businesses can now easily track and monitor the mobility of their employees and contractors on-site thanks to the new check-in tool.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The check-in feature is easy to use and straightforward. Utilizing their particular QR code, which is created by the Onfra system, employees and independent contractors can check in.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The system keeps track of their check-in time and location once they have checked in, making it easy for supervisors to monitor and track their movements.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The check-in tool helps with security and compliance while also giving organisations real-time visibility into the locations of their on-site personnel and contractors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Businesses can simply make sure that only authorised people are on their property and that they are adhering to the essential safety measures by using the check-in tool.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra offers a number of other helpful services to assist businesses in managing and tracking their visitors, employees, and contractors in addition to the check-in feature.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Businesses can easily generate and manage visitor badges, keep track of who enters and leaves the building, and even set up automatic alerts for important occasions like an employee or contractor's check-out time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The simplicity of use of Onfra is one of its main advantages. The system is simple and intuitive, so workers and contractors will need little training. Additionally, it is completely adaptable, enabling firms to customise the system to meet their own demands and specifications.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra is ideal for companies of all sizes because it is also very scalable. Onfra can assist you in managing and monitoring the on-site movements of your staff, whether you have a small staff or a huge workforce of contractors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In general, Onfra's new check-in tool is a game-changer for companies aiming to increase productivity and property security. Businesses can simply manage and monitor the mobility of their workers on-site, ensuring compliance and enhancing security, with real-time visibility of employee and contractor check-ins. Onfra is available right now, so give it a try.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->
