					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Revolutionizing Commercial Real Estate and Facility Management]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/revolutionizing-commercial-real-estate-and-facility-management/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 30 Mar 2023 17:16:26 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=1083</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Commercial real estate and facility management are essential to a well-functioning business. Commercial real estate and facility management significance is gradually increasing with the growth of the global economy. As we are at the start of 2023, it’s the right time to look ahead to the emerging trends that will shape the future of the real estate and facility management. In this article, we will explore top trends that are set to impact the real estate and facility management industry in the upcoming years.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The rise of smart buildings</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With more and more property managers investing in building automation systems (BAS) and internet of things (IoT) devices, smart buildings are becoming increasingly popular. Technologies like BAS and IOT allow for improved energy efficiency, better maintenance, and greater occupant comfort. All these features are an attractive proposition for both building owners and tenants.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The emergence of the hybrid workplace</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The COVID-19 pandemic has played a pivotal role in the emergence of the hybrid workplace. It has accelerated the shift towards remote work which has its own advantages and disadvantages. The hybrid workplace model combines both remote &amp; in-office work. This provides great flexibility for employees while also ensuring that businesses can maintain their physical presence. Hence, facility managers will need to adjust their strategies. the strategies shall be adjusted in such a way that they accommodate the needs of both remote and in-office workers.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Want to learn more about hybrid workplaces? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/onfra-the-key-to-enabling-effective-hybrid-work/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Click here</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The importance of Data and Analytics</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>There is a lot of data which is available to us in this industry. Proper analytics on the data can give us insights that will be fruitful for our businesses. Data analysis gives us the feel of data. Data and Analytics have become an essential part of facility management. This enables managers to track occupancy, and energy consumption. and other key metrics. The rise of smart buildings and IoT devices is generating a huge amount of data. This data is only set to increase, making it crucial for managers to have the tools and expertise to interpret this huge raw data. The interpretation and analysis obtained from this data through experts will help to make informed decisions.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The increasing role of automation</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Another trend that is all set to transform the real estate and facility management industry is Automation. From chatbots and virtual assistants to autonomous cleaning robots, automation has great potential to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Along with improving efficiency and reducing cost it also has the potential for freeing up time for facility managers to focus on more strategic tasks.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The shift towards outsourcing and partnerships</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Outsourcing and partnerships are becoming more prevalent in the real estate and facility management industry. This is because many businesses choose to partner with third-party providers to handle specific functions such as maintenance, cleaning, and security. <em>Shifting towards an outsourcing and partnerships</em> approach allows businesses to focus on their core competencies. Along with focusing on the core competencies they benefit from the expertise of specialist service providers.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"style":{"typography":{"textTransform":"capitalize"}}} -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading" style="text-transform:capitalize"><strong>The rise of flexibility and agility</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Flexibility and agility have become crucial in the post-COVID world Since businesses look for ways to adapt to changing circumstances quickly. This trend is particularly relevant in the real estate and facility management industry. Where managers must be prepared to adjust their strategies In response to shifting market conditions, changing regulations and evolving tenant needs, etc.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>The Emphasis on Health and Wellness</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The final and important trend that is going to impact real estate and facility management is <em>the emphasis on health and wellness</em>. Health and wellness have become increasingly important considerations in the real estate industry. This is because tenants are placing greater emphasis on factors such as air quality, natural light, cleanliness, and access to outdoor spaces. Facility managers must take these factors into account when designing and managing buildings. Taking these factors into consideration will ensure a healthy and supportive environment for occupants.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Learn more about <a href="https://globalwellnessinstitute.org/what-is-wellness/what-is-wellness-lifestyle-real-estate-communities/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">WELLNESS LIFESTYLE REAL ESTATE &amp; COMMUNITIES</a>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Wrap up</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, real estate and facility management is evolving rapidly, driven by technological advancements, shifting tenant needs, etc. The trends we have explored in the article highlight the importance of staying ahead of the curve. To stay ahead of the curve one must embrace new technologies, adopt innovative strategies, reduce costs, and enhance tenant satisfaction.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As the industry continues to evolve rapidly, it is essential for facility managers to remain flexible and adaptable. By doing so, they will be better positioned to thrive in an increasingly;y competitive and complex marketplace.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>FAQs</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>What is the role of technology in real estate and facility management? </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Technology plays an increasingly significant role in the industry, enabling facility managers to optimize building performance and reduce costs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>What are smart buildings, and why are they important in real estate management?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Smart buildings are buildings equipped with technology that enables them to automatically control various systems such as lighting, heating, and ventilation. They are essential in real estate management as they improve energy efficiency, maintenance, and occupant comfort.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true,"start":2} -->
<ol start="2"><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>How can facility managers incorporate sustainability into their operations?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facility managers can incorporate sustainability into their operations by implementing energy-efficient systems, water conservation practices, and waste reduction measures.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true,"start":3} -->
<ol start="3"><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>What is the hybrid workplace, and how will it affect real estate and facility management?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The hybrid workplace is a working model that combines both remote and in-office work. It will affect real estate and facility management by requiring managers to adjust their strategies to accommodate the needs of both remote and in-office workers.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true,"start":4} -->
<ol start="4"><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>How can facility managers use data and analytics to improve their operations?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facility managers can use data and analytics to track occupancy, energy consumption, etc which enables them to make informed decisions that will simultaneously improve their operations.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true,"start":5} -->
<ol start="5"><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>What is the importance of health and wellness in real estate management?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>tenants are placing greater emphasis on factors such as air quality, natural light, cleanliness, and access to outdoor spaces. Facility managers must take these factors into account when designing and managing buildings to ensure that they provide a healthy and supportive environment for occupants.</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Visitor management for the Pharmaceutical Industry]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/visitor-management-for-the-pharmaceutical-industry/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 30 Mar 2023 17:10:30 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=1094</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In the pharmaceutical industry, visitors play a crucial role in its growth and success. Here, visitors mean vendors, contractors, auditors, customers, etc. Visitors bring new ideas, partnerships, and opportunities to the company. However, managing visitors in this highly regulated industry can be a daunting task. From safeguarding confidential information to ensuring compliance with security protocols, pharmaceutical companies need to implement a robust visitor management system. In this article, we will be discussing about the following:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Why Effective Visitor management is crucial in Pharmaceutical Industry</strong>?</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Ideal Visitor management system for the Pharmaceutical industry.</strong></li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Why Effective Visitor management is crucial in Pharmaceutical Industry</strong>?</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>An effective Visitor management system is very crucial in the pharmaceutical industry for several reasons. A few reasons are discussed below.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Pre-registration</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Pharmaceutical companies should require visitors to pre-register before arriving on the premises. This will reduce the reception work and mess. Eventually, this will also eliminate the paper book maintenance for the visitors which reduces a lot of managing stress. The pre-registration process can include gathering visitor information, such as name, contact details, the purpose of visit, a government id, etc. Hence this can help streamline the check-in process and reduces the waiting time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Security and safety</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Pharmaceutical companies withhold sensitive and valuable information, products, and equipment. Therefore, it's vital to ensure that only authorized visitors with valid credentials enter the premises. A visitor management system can increase security by maintaining the visitor's record and only allowing authorized persons on the premises. A robust visitor management system can help to prevent theft, vandalism, espionage, and other security threats.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Compliance</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For Pharmaceutical companies, it is a must to comply with various regulations, such as <a href="https://ispe.org/initiatives/regulatory-resources/gmp/what-is-gmp#:~:text=GMP%20regulations%20require%20a%20quality,not%20effective%20or%20even%20dangerous." target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Good Manufacturing Practices(GMP)</a>, <a href="https://www.mailmodo.com/guides/hipaa/">Health Insurance Probability and Accountability Act(HIPAA)</a>, and Drug Enforcement Administration(DEA) rules. Visitor management systems can help ensure compliance with these regulations by verifying the visitor's identity, the purpose of the visit, etc.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Learn about data protection and its importance at Compliance with DPDPB</strong></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Protects Intellectual properties</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The Pharma industry would definitely want to protect its intellectual properties. A visitor management system can help pharmaceutical companies protect their intellectual properties by making visitors sign NDA (Non-disclosure agreement).</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Reputation</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Pharmaceutical companies are very reputation conscious. The reputation of the company can be affected by its visitors. Unprofessional or unethical conduct by visitors can defame the company. This can also damage the company's brand image and credibility, eventually leading to a huge loss. A well-designed visitor management system can help ensure that visitors follow the company's policies and code of conduct.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Emergency evacuation</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Pharmaceutical companies have to be prepared to handle emergency situations such as natural disasters, fire, security breaches, etc. Visitor management systems can help in identifying and locating visitors during an emergency which will ease the process of evacuation.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Know how a visitor management system can play a key role in an emergency evacuation. <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/key-role-of-visitor-management-system-in-emergency-evacuation/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Click here</a>.</em></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Ideal Visitor management system for the Pharmaceutical industry</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>An ideal visitor management system for the pharmaceutical industry shall possess the following qualities:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Scalability:</strong> This means visitor management should be scalable to handle a high volume of visitors. It should also be able to handle different types of visitors and various access requirements. It should be able to adapt to changing needs and accommodate in the future.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Security: </strong>The visitor management system should have robust security features. Security is crucial since pharmaceutical companies possess sensitive information which should be protected. Basically, it should have features such as identity verification, badge printing, background check, etc.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Compliance:</strong> The visitor management system should comply with various regulations, for example, DEA regulation. Features like visitor logging, audit trails, and data protection can ensure compliance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>User-friendly: </strong>The visitor management system for the pharmaceutical industry should be easy to use for visitors, employees, and administrators. The User interface should be simple to understand and easy to operate by anyone.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Integration: </strong>The visitor management system should integrate with other systems, such as access control, HR, and security. This will eventually provide a seamless visitor experience.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, Visitor managements are very essential for the pharmaceutical industry. An ideal visitor management system for pharmaceutical companies should have features like scalability, security, compliance, user-friendliness, integration, etc. By incorporating these qualities, pharmaceutical companies can streamline their visitor management processes, enhance security and compliance along with improving the visitor's experience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p></p>

		<title><![CDATA[Revolutionizing the Modern Offices with Tech Innovations]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/revolutionizing-the-modern-offices-with-tech-innovations/</link>
		<pubDate>Sun, 23 Apr 2023 10:10:03 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=1101</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Modern offices can be revolutionized with tech innovations?</strong></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's world of business, technology plays an increasingly important role in driving productivity, efficiency, and innovation. Technological innovations have changed the way we interact with colleagues and communicate with clients. We are witnessing a rapid transformation in the workplace due to constant technological advancements. Communication, collaboration, automation, and data analysis all rely on a range of cutting-edge tech solutions to meet the demands of today's competitive world. In this article, we will explore some of the latest tech innovations that are revolutionizing the modern office and how they can help you stay ahead of the curve.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Artificial Intelligence (AI)</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Artificial intelligence is transforming the modern office by enabling companies to automate mundane and repetitive tasks. This will help to free up time for employees to focus on more complex and creative work. AI-powered tools such as chatbots, voice assistants, and other software are becoming increasingly common in the workplace. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In modern offices, AI-powered tools are reducing the employee's cost to the company and increasing productivity. Chatbots, for instance, are being used by businesses to provide customers with instant answers to their queries. Eventually, this will enhance customer satisfaction. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Collaboration Tools</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Collaboration tools are transforming the modern office by enabling employees to work together seamlessly. The best advantage of the collaboration tool is employees can work together regardless of their location. Tools such as <a href="https://slack.com/intl/en-in">Slack</a>, <a href="https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/group-chat-software">Microsoft Teams</a>, and<a href="https://workspace.google.com/intl/en_in/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener"> Google Workspaces</a> are becoming increasingly popular. These tools allow teams to communicate, collaborate and share files in real-time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>These tools are also enabling businesses to embrace remote work. Remote work gives employees the ability to work from anywhere, maintain their work-life balance, etc. While businesses can save on office space and reduce overhead costs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Want to learn more about The Hybrid Workplace model? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/mastering-hybrid-work-a-comprehensive-guide/">Click Here.</a></em></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Visitor Management Systems</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This has been one of the vital tools for revolutionizing the modern office. This is a simple visitor management system application that can keep track of the visitors, schedule meetings, help in emergency evacuations, reduce workload at reception and reduce paperwork. Visitor management systems revolutionized the modern office by eliminating the unnecessary paperwork and workload created by the reception corner. Visitor management systems are rapidly adapted by modern offices due to their advantages. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A visitor management system will turn your reception into a smart reception which is a pivotal part of modern offices. Smart reception systems typically use kiosks or other devices to allow visitors to check in and out, and may also include features such as badge printing, appointment scheduling, and real-time visitor tracking. Smart reception systems can be beneficial in organizations that receive a high volume of visitors. Since they can help to improve efficiency &amp; reduce the workload for reception staff.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Planning to get a visitor management system for your workplace? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/visitor-management-system-enhancing-security-and-efficiency/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Click here</a></em>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR)</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Other tech innovations revolutionizing modern offices are Virtual and augmented reality technologies. Virtual and Augmented reality technologies are transforming the modern office by enabling businesses to create immersive experiences for their customers and employees. AR/VR technologies are being used in a wide range of applications, from virtual product demonstrations to virtual employee training. Basically, the whole concept of AR/VR makes online stuff more interactive and entertaining for users.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>For example, a furniture company can use VR technology to enable customers to visualize how their furniture would look in their homes. On the other hand, healthcare professionals can use VR to better prepare themselves for being in the operation theatre. VR is also used by retailers, by introducing the concept of <em>online shopping in the virtual world</em>. During the pandemic and lockdown, VR was also used by people for tourism. Hence VR/AR has a lot of applications in various domains.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Cloud Computing</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Cloud computing is another technological innovation that is revolutionizing the modern office. Cloud-based solutions such as <a href="https://azure.microsoft.com/en-in">Microsoft Azure</a>, <a href="https://aws.amazon.com/">Amazon web services</a>, and <a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google cloud platforms</a> are becoming increasingly popular. These are gaining popularity since they are helping in enabling businesses to store data, run applications, and access resources on demand. Cloud computing offers several benefits to businesses, including lower costs, greater flexibility, and enhanced security.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Cyber Security</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Cybersecurity is becoming more critical than ever before as businesses become increasingly reliant on technology. Cyber threats, fraud, Data leaks, etc are constantly evolving. Businesses must be proactive in protecting their data and systems from cyber-attacks.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Tech innovations such as artificial intelligence and machine learning are being used to enhance cybersecurity. They help in detecting and responding to threats in real-time more accurately and quickly. Businesses are also investing in cybersecurity training for their employees to ensure that they are aware of the latest threats and how to protect sensitive data.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

		<title><![CDATA[Mastering Your Workplace Visitor Policy with Onfra]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/mastering-your-workplace-visitor-policy-with-visitdesk/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 04 May 2023 00:22:45 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[admin_visitdesk]]></dc:creator>

		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Are you struggling to manage your workplace visitors? Do you have a visitor policy in place? If not, it’s high time you create one. But where to start? How to make it comprehensive, flexible, and scalable? Fortunately, there is a solution: Onfra.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In this article, we’ll show you how to create and scale your workplace visitor policy with Onfra, a cloud-based visitor management system that automates and streamlines visitor registration, check-in, and check-out. We’ll cover everything from the benefits of having a visitor policy to the key elements of a visitor policy and how to use Onfra to implement and enforce it. So, let’s get started!</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Benefits of Having a Visitor Policy</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Before we dive into the specifics of creating a visitor policy, let’s first understand why it’s essential to have one. Here are some of the benefits of having a visitor policy:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Security:</strong> A visitor policy helps ensure the security of your workplace by screening visitors, tracking their whereabouts, and preventing unauthorized access.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Safety:</strong> A visitor policy helps ensure the safety of your workplace by informing visitors of safety procedures, identifying potential hazards, and responding to emergencies.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Compliance:</strong> A visitor policy helps ensure compliance with regulations and standards such as GDPR, HIPAA, ISO, and OSHA.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Productivity:</strong> A visitor policy helps improve productivity by reducing wait times, enhancing communication, and minimizing disruptions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Image:</strong> A visitor policy helps enhance your image by creating a professional and welcoming environment for visitors, customers, and partners.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Key Elements of a Visitor Policy</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Now that you know the benefits of having a visitor policy let’s dive into the key elements of a visitor policy. A comprehensive visitor policy should include the following elements:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Purpose:</strong> The purpose of the visitor policy should be clearly stated, such as to ensure security, safety, compliance, productivity, and image.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Scope:</strong> The scope of the visitor policy should be clearly defined, such as who it applies to, what it covers, and what it doesn’t cover.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Responsibilities:</strong> The responsibilities of visitors, hosts, and administrators should be clearly outlined, such as who is responsible for registering visitors, escorting visitors, and monitoring visitors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Procedures:</strong> The procedures for visitor registration, check-in, and check-out should be clearly documented, such as how to pre-register visitors, how to issue visitor badges, and how to log visitor data.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Rules:</strong> The rules for visitors should be clearly communicated, such as what behavior is expected, what is prohibited, and what consequences apply.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Privacy:</strong> The privacy of visitors should be respected and protected, such as by obtaining their consent, securing their data, and complying with data protection laws.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Training:</strong> The training of visitors, hosts, and administrators should be provided, such as on how to use the visitor policy, how to handle emergencies, and how to report incidents.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Audit:</strong> The audit of the visitor policy should be conducted regularly, such as to assess its effectiveness, identify gaps, and implement improvements.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How to Create and Scale Your Workplace Visitor Policy with Onfra</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Now that you know the key elements of a visitor policy let’s see how to create and scale your visitor policy with Onfra. Here are the steps:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Identify your needs:</strong> First, identify your needs by assessing your current visitor management process, identifying its strengths and weaknesses, and defining your requirements.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Customize your policy:</strong> Second, customize your policy by tailoring the key elements of your visitor policy to your needs, such as by adapting the purpose, scope, responsibilities</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Configure Onfra:</strong> Third, configure Onfra by setting up your account, creating your locations, customizing your fields, and enabling your features.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Communicate your policy:</strong> Fourth, communicate your policy by publishing it on your website, displaying it in your reception area, and distributing it to your stakeholders.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Train your staff:</strong> Fifth, train your staff by providing them with access to Onfra, explaining the visitor policy, and demonstrating the procedures.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Enforce your policy:</strong> Sixth, enforce your policy by using Onfra to register visitors, issue badges, monitor activity, and enforce rules.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Analyze your data:</strong> Seventh, analyze your data by using Onfra to generate reports, identify trends, and make decisions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Improve your policy:</strong> Eighth, improve your policy by using Onfra to gather feedback, identify areas for improvement, and implement changes.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>By following these steps, you can create and scale your visitor policy with Onfra, a cloud-based visitor management system that makes it easy and efficient to manage your workplace visitors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How Onfra Works</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Now that you know how to create and scale your visitor policy with Onfra, let’s see how Onfra works. Onfra is a cloud-based visitor management system that provides a simple and secure way to register, track, and manage your visitors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Here are the main features of Onfra:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Pre-registration:</strong> Visitors can pre-register online or via email, saving time and reducing errors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Self-check-in:</strong> Visitors can check-in using a tablet or smartphone, avoiding queues and minimizing contact.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Badge printing:</strong> Visitors can receive a custom badge with their photo, name, and purpose, enhancing security and identification.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Host notifications:</strong> Hosts can receive real-time notifications of their visitors’ arrival, location, and purpose, facilitating communication and coordination.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Compliance check:</strong> Visitors can be screened for compliance with regulations and policies, such as health, safety, and security.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Evacuation report:</strong> Visitors can be accounted for in case of an emergency, such as a fire or a lockdown, improving safety and readiness.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Data analytics:</strong> Visitors can be tracked and analyzed for insights and improvements, such as visitor volume, duration, and frequency.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Onfra is a versatile and scalable solution that can be used by any organization, regardless of size or industry. Whether you’re a small business, a multinational corporation, a government agency, or a non-profit organization, Onfra can help you create and scale your visitor policy.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>FAQs</strong></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Here are some frequently asked questions about creating and scaling your workplace visitor policy with Onfra:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Do I need a visitor policy if I don’t have many visitors?</strong> Yes, you still need a visitor policy, even if you don’t have many visitors. A visitor policy helps ensure the security, safety, compliance, productivity, and image of your workplace, regardless of the number of visitors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>How can I customize my visitor policy with Onfra?</strong> You can customize your visitor policy with Onfra by using the customizable fields and features, such as the purpose, scope, responsibilities, procedures, rules, privacy, training, and audit.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Can I integrate Onfra with my other systems?</strong> Yes, you can integrate Onfra with your other systems, such as your access control, HR, CRM, and marketing systems, using APIs and webhooks.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>How can I train my staff on Onfra?</strong> You can train your staff on Onfra by providing them with access to the system, explaining the visitor policy, demonstrating the procedures, and providing support and feedback.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>What if I have a multi-location or multi-building workplace?</strong> Onfra is designed to handle multi-location or multi-building workplaces, allowing you to create and manage different locations and buildings, and customize the fields and features accordingly.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Can I use Onfra for events and meetings as well?</strong> Yes, you can use Onfra for events and meetings as well, by creating custom registration forms and badges, and managing the attendance and feedback.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>How can I ensure the privacy and security of my visitors’ data?</strong> Onfra takes the privacy and security of your visitors’ data seriously, by implementing industry-standard measures, such as encryption, access control, audit trail, and data retention policy.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>How can I measure the ROI of Onfra?</strong> You can measure the ROI of Onfra by calculating the time, cost, and risk savings, as well as the satisfaction and feedback of your visitors and stakeholders.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Conclusion</strong></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, creating and scaling your workplace visitor policy with Onfra is a smart and efficient way to ensure the security, safety, compliance, productivity, and image of your workplace. By following the steps outlined in this article, and using the features and benefits of Onfra, you can create a visitor policy that suits your needs and goals, and adapt it to changing circumstances and feedback. With Onfra, you can streamline your visitor management process, reduce your workload, and enhance your visitor experience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>So, don't wait any longer, start using Onfra today and see the results for yourself! <strong><a href="https://app.onfra.io/signup">signup now</a></strong></p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[Celebrating World Facilities Management Day 2023: A Tribute to essential workers]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/celebrating-world-facilities-management-day-2023-a-tribute-to-essential-workers/</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 09 May 2023 17:49:29 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=1221</guid>

		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Introduction</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>World Facilities Management Day is observed annually on Wednesday of the second whole week of May, This year it falls on the 10th of May 2023. This day is celebrated to pay tribute to all the hard work and dedication of facility managers who keep our buildings, offices, and homes in good shape. Without their contributions, we cannot imagine what our homes, buildings, offices, and hospitals would look like. We often get into a place and feel how smoothly everything is managed, we see that the staff is perfect, the check-in checkout is perfect, and the service was excelled but did you wonder who is behind this? <strong>Yes, facility managers/ professionals</strong> make it possible for you to have a first-class experience. Facility managers or Facility management professionals are behind the scenes to ensure the task they are appointed with is done perfectly leaving you with zero complaints.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>History of Facilities Management Day</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>World Facilities Management Day, initiated by Global F.M., was first observed on August 28, 2009. The exact date of the day has been reportedly changed over the years. It was celebrated on the fourth Thursday of June 2010 to 2013; on Wednesday of the first full week of June 2014 to 2015; on July 13, 2016; and on Wednesday of the second full week of May from 2017 to present. Although the date has been very dynamic the aim of World Facilities Management Day has always been constant. This is the day to recognize, appreciate, and celebrate the contributions of essential workers working tirelessly in facilities management.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>If a facility manager is doing his job perfectly then a company/building/workplace or any organization has already solved its half of the problem. Facility managers look after a lot of tasks such as looking over the switches and boards if they are working properly, making sure that the hotel rooms are cleaned and ready to accept guests making sure the traffic flow is smooth near the office gate, making sure the security is strong enough to let intruder break-in and many more. There are a bunch of people who are working behind this day and night tirelessly. Hence, to appreciate their work and to let them know that we care about them we celebrate Worl Facilities Management Day.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What is Facility Management and Why it is important?</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>When asked with Google about what is facility management it simply defines it as<strong><em> " the maintenance of an organization's buildings and equipment".</em></strong> Well, let's discuss more about this.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Do you know who manages the security of a building? Do you know who looks after the cleanliness of the building? Do you know who is responsible to fix the water, electricity, or technical issues work? Yes, A technician who helps you with your technical issues, a plumber who fixes your water pipes, an electrician who looks after your electrical wires issues, a cleaner who makes sure your building or workplace is clean, these people are all who are designated as <strong>Essential Workers</strong>. They are the base of facility management. They look after every task they are appointed with and <strong>Facility Managers</strong> are the ones who ensure these tasks are done. The role of a facility manager is to ensure that a building or facility or workplace is running smoothly and efficiently. They also ensure that the visitors or occupants inside the building are safe and comfortable.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facility Management is an essential function for any organization since it ensures that the physical infrastructure is in good condition. They also ensure that all the operations that are being performed can continue without interruption.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Learnings from COVID-19</strong> <strong>For Facilities Management</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":5} -->
<h5 class="wp-block-heading">The Role of Facilities Management in Fighting the COVID-19 Outbreak.</h5>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>COVID-19 was something that shook facilities management. But kudos to all the essential workers and facility managers for standing strong and not giving up. COVID-19 was something that facility management didn't expect and this created chaos and panic in the initial. But facility managers and essential workers came back stronger, created strategies, fought the pandemic, gave their lives, and set themselves as an example for the upcoming people. This was a tough job for especially facility managers and essential workers in the sector of healthcare since hospitals were flooded with COVID-19 patients. The pandemic required a holistic perspective in order to find feasible solutions in facilities management. Eventually, facility management learned a lot from covid-19 pandemic and faced the challenges with their chin up. <a href="https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9888426/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Study more</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Key Challenges of Facilities Management in 2023</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A sign of a good facility manager is they take up facilities management challenges to efficiently maintain their office building/ organization and infrastructure in good condition. Growing and adjusting to new changes are difficult, especially for firmly established industries that have been providing the same services for decades. But, to survive one must adapt to the changes and does facilities management does. Below we will discuss briefly a few key challenges of facilities management in 2023 along with solutions to tackle them.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>1.</strong> <strong>Lack of information availability</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>One of the key challenges facing by facility management in 2023 is the lack of information availability. Facility managers require access to a wide range of information. The access to information will help facility managers make informed decisions about building maintenance, repairs, and upgrades. However, with the increasing complexity in building systems, the sheer volume of data is being generated. The need to integrate data from multiple sources makes it difficult for facility managers to access the information they require.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The traditional way of storing information which is paperwork procedures makes it difficult to access reliable facility information which eventually slows down the operations and requires unnecessary efforts. Due to a lack of information, field teams are unable to get the required facility data, and facility managers or leadership teams are unable to see operations clearly.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Solution</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To overcome the challenge of the lack of information, facility managers must adopt new strategies for data management and analysis. This may include investing in new technologies such as maintenance software. It may also require developing new partnerships with vendors and suppliers to ensure that data is being collected and shared effectively.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Another key strategy for overcoming this challenge is to invest in training and development for facility management teams. Providing the staff of the organization with the skills and knowledge will enhance their performance and also allow them to make informed decisions.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>2. Flexibility</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Flexibility is one of the critical issues for facility management in 2023. The changing demographics of the workplace, technological advancement, and evolving work styles all are driving the need for a more flexible work environment.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The demand for flexibility in the workplace is increasing since COVID-19 brought the concept of remote work. Facility managers must be able to accommodate these changing workstyles along with this they must ensure that buildings and facilities are safe &amp; secure. This will require a more agile and adaptable approach towards facility management.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Solution</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facility managers can overcome this challenge by leveraging technology. Such as sensors, building automation systems, Visitor management systems, and other mobile apps to manage the building and its operations efficiently. Incorporating flexible workplaces such as hotdesks and shared workplaces into their facility design can also be a good move.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>3. Diversity and Inclusion</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Diversity and inclusion are also critical issues for facility management in 2023. The changing demographics of the workplace, cultural norms, and evolving work styles all are driving the need for a more diverse and inclusive work environment. This requires a more inclusive approach to facility management, that takes into account the needs of different groups of people.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Solution</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facility managers can overcome this challenge by designing buildings that are accessible and can accommodate a wide range of needs. This can include incorporating features such as ramps, elevators, restrooms, and other necessary demands.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>4. Sustainability</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Another key challenge for facilities management in 2023 is Sustainability. As the world becomes increasingly focused on reducing its carbon footprint and preserving natural resources, facility managers must adopt new strategies. The strategies for managing buildings and facilities shall be both efficient and environmentally responsible.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Solution</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Energy Efficiency: </strong>Facility managers must take a proactive approach toward reducing energy consumption. Such as adopting strategies such as using energy-efficient appliances, and installing energy-efficient lighting and HVAC systems. Also using IoT technology in converting buildings to smart buildings will optimize energy use. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Water conservation:</strong> Facility managers must find ways to reduce water consumption and waste. Strategies such as installing low-flow faucets and toilets, implementing rainwater harvesting systems, etc. These strategies can help to conserve water and reduce costs.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Waste Reduction:</strong> Buildings generate huge amounts of waste including hazardous waste, municipal waste, and construction waste. Facility managers can reduce waste by implementing recycling programs, implementing Reuse and reducing, and designing buildings with a focus on waste reduction.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Renewable energy:</strong> The use of renewable energy is becoming very popular in every sector. Facility management has also started implementing renewable energy in buildings and organizations. Facility managers can reduce their reliance on traditional sources of energy by installing solar panels, wind turbines, and other renewable energy systems. This will help to reduce greenhouse gases emission and conserve energy which leads to reduced energy costs.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Top Trends in Facilities Management</strong> <strong>2023</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Smart buildings Technology(Iot)</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Smart building technologies are a continued trend in 2023. The use of technologies such as sensors etc to optimize building operations and productivity is on the rise. Smart building technology (IoT) can help facility managers to identify and address issues quickly. This also helps them to make informed decisions. This thereby improves building operations, reduces energy consumption, and improves maintenance.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Focus on sustainability</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Sustainability is another trend in 2023 in facilities management.  As the world becomes increasingly focused on reducing its carbon footprint and preserving natural resources, facility managers must adopt new strategies. The strategies for managing buildings and facilities shall be both efficient and environmentally responsible. Some of the strategies could be:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Installing renewable energy systems.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Implementing waste reduction.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Using energy-efficient equipment.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Acknowledge people about sustainability.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Increase the Use of Automation</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The use of automation is expected to increase in facilities management in 2023. With the rise in artificial intelligence and machine learning, automation is a constant trend. Automation technologies such as robotics, drones, and automatic vehicles/self-driving vehicles can play a huge role in facilities management. Facility managers can use them to perform tasks more efficiently, reduce labor costs and improve safety.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Wrap Up</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, World Facilities Management Day 2023 parents a unique opportunity to reflect on the importance of facility management. It also emphasizes the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead for Facility managers. By embracing new technology, focusing on sustainability, and adapting inclusion, diversity &amp; flexibility, Managers can overcome the challenges of 2023. This way they can build a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable future. Let us take a moment to appreciate and thank the hardworking professionals of Facilities Management.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em><strong>Hey, your building/organization might need visitor management. Know <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/all-about-a-visitor-management-system/">why?</a></strong></em></p>

		<title><![CDATA[Workplace Threats You Must Know About!]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/workplace-threats-you-must-know-about/</link>
		<pubDate>Wed, 24 May 2023 06:45:44 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>

		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What are workplace threats?</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Workplace threats are referred to as activities that threaten workplace security. Or, activities that threaten a workplace's safety and security are called workplace threats. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's business environment, workplace safety is more important than ever it has been. with the rise of workplace threats in recent years, it is crucial for organizations to ensure workplace safety. Organizations/employers shall take steps to mitigate risks and keep their employees safe and secure. Threats to an organization are numerous, and they’re certainly ineluctable. However, an efficient enterprise is one that not only focuses on its progress but also concentrates equally on safeguarding the company against the various threat(s) it may be subjected to. Below we will discuss some of the very common workplace threats along with tips to tackle them.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>7 Types of Workplace Threats</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Physical Violence</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This is the top most serious threat to workplace safety. Physical violence can take many forms, from assault to armed robbery. In order to protect your employees from physical violence, you need to have a comprehensive safety plan. This could include training from your employees on how to recognize and respond to violence. Another important step in preventing workplace violence is we can also conduct background checks before onboarding a candidate for a particular role in your company. This background check can help us to know about the candidates' past criminal history if any. Organization or employer has to ensure that the security measures are well implemented. Implementing security measures include surveillance cameras, metal detectors, and access control systems.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Another important step in preventing workplace violence is to scan government ids before entry into the premises. Scanning government ids can help employers firstly by getting details of the visitor. Secondly, with this data available we can easily track the person if required in the future. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Want to know<strong> the Perks of Visitor Management with Government ID scanning</strong></em>? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/perks-of-visitor-management-with-government-ids-scanning/">Click Here.</a></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Cyber threats</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's digital age, cyber threats are a growing concern for all businesses. From data breaches to malware attacks, cybercriminals can cause serious damage to your business. To protect your business from cyber threats, it's important that an organization or a business opt for a comprehensive plan.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Companies must understand their cybersecurity vulnerabilities to safeguard against a cyber attack. Some of the risks might be privilege abuse, data mishandling, unapproved hardware, and software etc. Some of the measures a company can take are strong passwords, firewalls, antivirus software, and regular data backups. Another important measure towards cyber attacks is training your employees on how to recognize and respond to phishing scams and other types of cyber attacks.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Workplace Violence</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Another workplace threat is workplace violence. Workplace violence has been the number 1 critical issue over the last few years. According to the&nbsp;<em><a href="https://www.securitymagazine.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">security magazine</a></em>, workplace violence has been maintaining the top spot for&nbsp;<em><strong>critical problems in the workplace</strong></em>&nbsp;as the&nbsp;<strong>number 1</strong>&nbsp;position. These cases have been in a surge in retail workers, teachers &amp; health professionals, etc. In a recently published report by&nbsp;<a href="https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/index.htm" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">National Institute for occupational safety and Health</a>&nbsp;and the other two agencies says that over the last 6 years workplace violence-related deaths have risen 11% from 2014.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Preventing workplace violence requires an extensive approach that can address the underlying causes and risk factors. Here are some strategies that organizations can implement:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Prevention policy: </strong>Organizations should develop a clear workplace violence prevention policy. It should be defined in the policy what constitutes workplace violence, outline reporting procedures, and detail the consequences for violating the policy.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Training &amp; Education: </strong>Training and education programs are essential for educating employees and management about the risks, recognizing warning signs, and how to respond to such incidents. These programs can also provide employees with conflict-resolution skills, and de-escalation techniques and promote a culture of respect and professionalism.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Screening and Background Checks: </strong>Screening and background checks are essential tools for identifying potentially violent individuals during the hiring process. These checks can include criminal record checks, reference checks, psychological assessments, etc.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Supply chain Disruption</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's interconnected global economy, supply chain disruption has become a significant concern for businesses across various industries. Disruption can arise from a range of factors. These factors could be natural disasters, political instability, pandemics, transportation issues, and more. All these disruptions can have a severe impact on a company's operations, profitability, and also reputation.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>According to a 2022 survey&nbsp;by Blue Yonder, 88% of businesses faced disruption in 2021 due to supply chain issues.&nbsp;The disruptions in supply chain management affect the productivity of various companies to a great extent. For instance, the cost to import products from China may rise to a peak in the near future. Companies and their leaders should continually assess and manage supply chain risks. Therefore, it is essential for businesses to understand the risks and implement smart strategies. Strategies shall be designed in such a way that they mitigate the effects of supply chain disruption.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Natural Disasters</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Natural disasters can also pose a huge threat to workplace safety. By word natural disasters we mean hurricanes, floods, and earthquakes. To protect your employees from these types of threats, you should have an emergency response plan. This can include evacuating the building, communicating with employees (via notification), and emergency services. A visitor management system can play a pivotal role in an emergency evacuation. A <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/onfra-the-key-to-enabling-effective-hybrid-work/">visitor management system</a> is an essential tool for ensuring the safety of any gated community in case of emergency. These systems are crucial in enabling quick and effective evacuation during emergencies. Hence,  it is important for all organizations to prioritize workplace safety and have plans in place to evacuate the premises in case of an emergency. Utilizing a Visitor management system like <a href="https://onfra.io/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Onfra </a>can greatly aid in ensuring a smooth and safe evacuation process.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Want to understand the role of the visitor management system in emergency evacuation? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/mobile-apps-and-flexible-work-empowering-remote-teams/">Click here.</a></em></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Theft of intellectual property</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Intellectual property (IP) is a non-physical asset that a person or corporation possesses. Some of the types of intellectual property are patents, trademarks, copyrights, and trade secrets. IP plays a crucial role, they protect the creation of individuals and businesses. Theft of intellectual property could lead to legal issues. Hence businesses and individuals should be aware of and protect their intellectual property. Some of the ways to protect intellectual property are to document the process, apply for the trade mark and keep it a secret.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>Want to read in detail about intellectual property? <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/world-intellectual-property-day-2023/">Click here.</a></em></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Health threats</strong></h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Health threats are a very prevailing threat to the workplace. With the rise of junk food, pollution, and other issues diseases are growing day by day. Organizations should plan mitigation strategies and keep themselves prepared for it.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[The Ultimate Guide to Building an Effective Employee Onboarding Process]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/the-ultimate-guide-to-building-an-effective-employee-onboarding-process/</link>
		<pubDate>Fri, 14 Jul 2023 14:32:43 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=1273</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Introduction</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's fast-paced business environment, a seamless onboarding experience is crucial for organizations to ensure new employees can quickly adapt to their roles and contribute effectively. Efficient employee onboarding not only saves time and resources but also enhances employee productivity and satisfaction. In this article, we will explore the best practices and strategies to create an efficient employee onboarding experience that sets the stage for success.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">The Importance of Efficient Employee Onboarding</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Efficient onboarding is essential for several reasons. Firstly, it enables new employees to become familiar with the company's technology infrastructure and tools. This will allow them to perform their duties efficiently from day one. Secondly, a well-structured onboarding process helps to build confidence and reduces the learning curve. This ensures that new hires are productive in a shorter period. Finally, a positive onboarding experience fosters employee engagement, job satisfaction, and retention, as employees feel supported and valued right from the start.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Key Elements of an Efficient Employee Onboarding Process</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To create an efficient employee onboarding experience, organizations should consider incorporating the following key elements:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">1. Pre-Onboarding Preparation</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Before the new employee's first day, it's crucial to have a comprehensive pre-onboarding process in place. This involves preparing the necessary equipment. By the word equipment, we mean computers, software, and access credentials, to ensure a smooth transition into the role. Additionally, providing pre-boarding materials, such as orientation guides and training resources, will help new hires familiarize themselves with the company's IT systems and processes.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">2. Personalized Onboarding Plan</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Each new employee is unique, and their onboarding plan should reflect that. Tailoring the employee onboarding experience based on the employee's role, responsibilities, and skill level should be done. This can significantly improve their ability to succeed. The plan should outline specific objectives, milestones, and training modules, providing a clear roadmap for the new hire's integration into the organization.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">3. Onsite Orientation and Training</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>On the employee's first day, a comprehensive onsite orientation and training session should be conducted. This session should cover essential IT policies, security protocols, and software applications relevant to the employee's role. Additionally, providing an overview of the company's IT infrastructure and support channels can help the new hire navigate their technology environment more effectively.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">4. Mentorship and Buddy Programs</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Pairing new employees with experienced mentors/buddies can also greatly enhance the onboarding experience. Mentors can provide guidance, answer questions, and share best practices, helping new hires acclimate to their roles and the organization more quickly. This support system creates a sense of community and fosters relationships within the company.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">5. Ongoing Support and Training</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The onboarding training and support should be restricted to only new employees. Efficient onboarding should not end after the initial training period. Providing ongoing support and training opportunities ensures that new employees stay up-to-date with evolving technologies and processes. Regular check-ins, refresher courses, and access to a knowledge base or intranet can empower employees to continuously improve their IT skills and remain productive contributors to the organization.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">FAQs</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: How long does an efficient employee onboarding process typically take?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: The duration of an efficient employee onboarding process can vary depending on the complexity of the role and the organization's specific requirements. However, on average, a well-designed onboarding program can range from one to three months.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: What are the common challenges in employee onboarding?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: Some common challenges in employee onboarding include outdated or insufficient training materials, lack of clear communication, technical issues during the onboarding process, and limited access to necessary resources and systems.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: How can organizations measure the effectiveness of their onboarding process?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: Organizations can measure the effectiveness of their employee onboarding process through various means, such as tracking the time taken for new hires to become productive, conducting surveys to gauge employee satisfaction, and monitoring retention rates among recently onboarded employees.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: Are there any specific legal or security considerations for employee onboarding?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: Yes, employee onboarding should adhere to legal and security considerations. This includes ensuring compliance with data protection regulations, providing employees with appropriate access rights based on their roles, and educating them about cybersecurity best practices.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: How can employee onboarding contribute to employee retention?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: A positive and efficient employee onboarding experience sets the stage for long-term employee satisfaction and engagement. When new employees feel supported, valued, and equipped with the necessary tools and knowledge, they are more likely to stay with the organization, reducing turnover and the associated costs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: What role does leadership play in the onboarding process?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: leadership plays a critical role in the employee onboarding process. They are responsible for setting the vision, establishing clear expectations, and providing the necessary resources and support for successful IT onboarding. Additionally, IT leaders should foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement to ensure the onboarding process evolves with changing technologies and employee needs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: What are the 4 Cs of effective onboarding?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: The four Cs are&nbsp;<strong>Compliance, Clarification, Connection, and Culture</strong>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Q: What are the 5 Cs of strategic onboarding?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A: The 5 Cs of Strategic Onboarding refer to five key elements that organizations should focus on to ensure a successful and effective onboarding process for new employees. These elements are:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Compliance: The first "C" involves ensuring that new hires are familiar with and adhere to all relevant legal, regulatory, and policy requirements. This includes providing necessary training on compliance-related matters, such as safety protocols, data protection, and company policies.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Clarification: The second "C" emphasizes the importance of clarifying expectations and responsibilities. New employees should have a clear understanding of their roles, goals, and performance expectations. This involves setting achievable objectives, providing job descriptions, and communicating key performance indicators (KPIs) to align their work with organizational objectives.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Culture: The third "C" focuses on integrating new employees into the company culture. It involves familiarizing them with the organization's values, mission, and vision. Companies should create opportunities for new hires to connect with colleagues, participate in team-building activities, and understand the company's working environment.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Connection: The fourth "C" highlights the significance of establishing rapport and relationships within the organization. Building a network of colleagues, mentors, and managers helps new hires feel supported and engaged. Encouraging interactions, assigning mentors, and facilitating introductions can accelerate the process of building professional relationships.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Confidence: The fifth "C" centers around instilling confidence in new employees. Organizations should provide the necessary resources, training, and feedback to help new hires develop the skills and knowledge required to excel in their roles. Recognizing achievements and celebrating milestones also contribute to building their confidence and motivation.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Creating an efficient employee onboarding experience is a strategic investment that is also time taking. But that will yield numerous benefits for organizations. By implementing pre-onboarding preparation, personalized onboarding plans, comprehensive training, mentorship programs, and ongoing support, organizations can empower new hires to become productive contributors quickly. An effective employee onboarding process not only reduces time and costs but also enhances employee satisfaction, engagement, and retention. Organizations can set the stage for long-term success by prioritizing employee onboarding and ensuring their employees have the tools and knowledge needed to thrive.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->

<!-- /wp:paragraph -->
