					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[How to Master the Art of Visitor Management]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/how-to-master-the-art-of-visitor-management/</link>
		<pubDate>Tue, 30 Apr 2024 18:29:38 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2854</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Discover top strategies for effective visitor management: streamline processes, utilize technology, and create welcoming environments.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/why-is-visitor-management-important/">Visitor Management System</a> is an application used to track, manage, and monitor visitors to a particular location. It offers a streamlined approach to visitor registration, check-in, and check-out processes, enhancing security,&nbsp;<a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/unlocking-workplace-efficiency-with-ai-tools-and-prompts-for-facility-management-success/">efficiency</a>, and overall visitor experience. Its application is not limited to office but is also helpful in Event management, Hospitals, schools, etc.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How Does a Visitor Check-in App Work?</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In the 1960s, visitors were greeted by receptionists, but today, modern offices use check-in apps like <a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a>. Visitors sign in on a tablet, notify their host, and provide extra information as needed.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">What Are the Benefits?</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Electronic visitor management systems impress customers by eliminating wait times and inefficiencies typically associated with manual check-in processes. With electronic check-in, your company appears sleek and innovative, reflecting positively on your brand.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Customers prioritize efficiency and streamlined processes, making electronic check-in systems a valuable asset. These systems enhance customer satisfaction and retention by ensuring a smooth and reliable check-in experience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>By utilizing a check-in app or virtual receptionist, you can greet customers warmly with their information readily available, facilitating a positive first impression. Additionally, customer data captured electronically enables future marketing opportunities, regardless of immediate transactions.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Virtual receptionists or check-in apps offer cost-efficient alternatives to traditional receptionists, allowing for increased productivity and versatility in office tasks.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Visitor Management as an Art</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>According to a survey in Fast Company, most customers nowadays like doing things themselves. In fact, 70 percent of people expect websites to have self-service options. This isn't just a temporary thing—it's how business will be in the future. And we're seeing it happen already, like with self-checkout at grocery stores and stores without cashiers, like Amazon and Sam's Club.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">In Conclusion-</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, mastering visitor management involves prioritizing efficiency, security, and guest experience. By implementing streamlined processes, leveraging technology, and fostering a welcoming environment, organizations can create positive impressions, enhance safety, and ultimately improve their overall operations.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Introduction</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/welcome-to-visitdesk-one-stop-solution-for-all-vms-requirements/">Biometric technologies</a> have revolutionized various aspects of security, identity verification, and anti-money laundering (AML) efforts. In the realm of visitor management, these technologies play a pivotal role in ensuring secure access, accurate identification, and regulatory compliance. This article delves into the diverse landscape of Professional Visitor Management Solution, from <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/enhancing-visitor-management-qr-codes-to-face-recognition-technology/">facial recognition</a> to iris recognition, shedding light on their functionalities, practical applications, technical intricacies, and future trends.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Exploration of the Topics</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Facial Recognition</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Facial recognition technology analyzes facial features to verify an individual's identity. Its applications range from unlocking smartphones to securing sensitive facilities. For instance, in visitor management systems, facial recognition streamlines check-in processes, enhances security, and creates seamless experiences for guests.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Liveness Detection</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Liveness detection is crucial for preventing spoofing attacks where fraudulent individuals attempt to use static images or videos to bypass facial recognition systems. This technology ensures that the biometric data captured is from a live person, thus enhancing the system's security and reliability.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Face Matching (1:1)</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Face matching, also known as verification, compares a live facial image against a stored reference image to authenticate an individual's identity. It is commonly used in access control systems, where users need to prove their identity before gaining entry to restricted areas.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Photo ID Matching (1:1)</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Similar to face matching, photo ID matching compares a live image captured by a camera with the photo on an identification document, such as a driver's license or passport. This additional layer of verification helps confirm the authenticity of the ID and the identity of the individual presenting it.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Face Search (1:N)</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Face search, or identification, involves matching a live facial image against a database of stored images to find potential matches. This technology is invaluable in law enforcement, border control, and large-scale event security, where rapid identification of individuals is paramount.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Age Verification</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Age verification utilizes biometric data, such as facial features, to estimate a person's age accurately. It finds applications in age-restricted environments like bars, casinos, and tobacco retailers, ensuring compliance with legal age requirements.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">On-Premise Solution</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>On-premise biometric solutions offer organizations the flexibility to host their biometric data and processing systems internally, providing greater control over data security and privacy. These solutions are preferred in industries with stringent regulatory requirements or sensitive data handling protocols.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Iris Recognition</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Iris recognition technology captures high-resolution images of the unique patterns in a person's iris to verify their identity. Its high accuracy and reliability make it suitable for access control, border crossings, and national identification programs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">AML (Anti-Money Laundering)</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Biometric technologies play a crucial role in AML efforts by enhancing customer due diligence processes, detecting suspicious activities, and mitigating financial risks. Biometric authentication adds an extra layer of security to financial transactions, reducing the likelihood of identity theft and fraud.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Practical Applications</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In the realm of visitor management, biometric technologies offer a myriad of practical applications:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Streamlining check-in processes: Facial recognition expedites the check-in process for visitors by eliminating the need for manual registration or badge issuance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Enhancing security: Biometric access control systems ensure that only authorized individuals gain entry to secure facilities, reducing the risk of unauthorized access or tailgating.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Preventing identity fraud: Photo ID matching verifies the authenticity of identification documents, mitigating the risk of identity theft or impersonation.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Ensuring regulatory compliance: Biometric age verification solutions help businesses comply with age-restricted regulations, such as selling alcohol or tobacco products.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Technical Details</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Professional visitor management solution like <strong><em>Biometric technologies</em></strong> boast impressive technical capabilities:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Accuracy: Facial recognition algorithms continually improve in accuracy, minimizing false positives and negatives.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Scalability: Biometric systems can scale to accommodate large volumes of users without compromising performance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Adaptability: These technologies can adapt to varying environmental conditions, such as changes in lighting or facial expressions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Integration and Implementation</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Integrating biometric technologies into existing visitor management systems is seamless:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Compatibility: Biometric solutions are compatible with a wide range of hardware and software systems, facilitating smooth integration.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>On-premise solutions: Organizations can deploy on-premise biometric systems to maintain full control over data security and compliance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Customer Success Stories</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Numerous organizations have successfully implemented biometric visitor management solutions:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Corporate offices: Companies utilize facial recognition for secure access to office buildings, ensuring only employees and authorized visitors enter the premises.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Airports: Airports leverage biometric systems for passport control and boarding processes, expediting passenger flows and enhancing security.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Hotels: Hotels deploy biometric check-in systems to provide guests with a seamless and secure experience, reducing wait times at reception desks.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>click <a href="https://youtu.be/yGwIqj1bNCI?feature=shared">here</a>, to learn how to Sign-up on Onfra.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Future Trends</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The future of biometric technologies in visitor management is promising:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Enhanced user experience: Innovations such as touchless biometrics and multimodal authentication will further improve user experiences and security.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Privacy enhancements: Advances in privacy-preserving biometrics will address concerns about data protection and consent.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Integration with IoT and AI: Biometric systems will integrate with Internet of Things (IoT) devices and artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to provide context-aware security solutions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, <a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a> using biometric technologies have transformed visitor management by offering secure, efficient, and compliant solutions. From facial recognition to iris scanning, these technologies continue to evolve, promising even greater advancements in security, identity verification, and anti-money laundering efforts, <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/the-worst-advice-about-visitor-management/">Onfra </a>has got your back!. By embracing <a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a>, organizations can enhance their security posture, streamline operations, and deliver exceptional professional visitor management solution and experiences.</p>

		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/four-reasons-why-employees-are-embracing-technological-advancements/</link>

<h2>Introduction</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>While employers often see technology as a means to improve business operations, they may overlook its benefits for employees. Now, it's crucial to consider how <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/revolutionizing-the-modern-offices-with-tech-innovations/">technological innovations</a> benefit the workforce, as the employee experience is increasingly important. Research indicates that with remote work becoming more common, many employees are considering changing jobs. Technology not only changes how employees work but also influences their attitudes toward their jobs and employers.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Here, we explore four positive impacts of technology on the workforce:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Increased efficiency</strong>: Technology automates repetitive tasks, reducing the time and effort required for manual work. For example, software programs can handle data entry and analysis more quickly and accurately than humans, allowing employees to focus on higher-value tasks that require creativity and critical thinking.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Enhanced collaboration</strong>: Digital tools such as video conferencing, instant messaging, and cloud-based platforms enable real-time communication and document sharing among team members, even if they are located in different offices or countries. This seamless collaboration fosters innovation, accelerates decision-making, and strengthens team cohesion.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Skills development opportunities</strong>: Technology provides employees with access to a wealth of online resources, including e-learning platforms, webinars, and virtual workshops. These resources allow employees to acquire new skills and knowledge at their own pace, empowering them to take ownership of their professional development and adapt to evolving job requirements.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Improved work-life balance</strong>: Remote work options and flexible scheduling, made possible by technology, enable employees to better manage their workloads and personal commitments. For example, telecommuting eliminates the need for lengthy commutes, while flexible work hours accommodate employees' individual preferences and responsibilities outside of work. This flexibility promotes employee well-being, reduces stress, and enhances job satisfaction.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, employees are embracing technological advances because of:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Enhanced efficiency through automation.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Improved collaboration via digital tools.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Opportunities for skill development.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Better work-life balance with remote work options.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>These advancements <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/struggling-with-low-productivity-at-work/">boost productivity</a> and job <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/the-right-vms-platform-visitdesk/"> satisfaction</a>, driving their acceptance in the workplace.</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[3 Ways to Prepare for the Future of Work]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/3-ways-to-prepare-for-the-future-of-work/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 02 May 2024 16:43:59 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2877</guid>

		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Introduction</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today’s ever-evolving workplace landscape, the integration of technology plays a pivotal role. With a particular focus on enhancing employee experiences and operational efficiencies, touchless check-in and check-out systems stand out as transformative tools for future-ready businesses. Learn more about how these systems are shaping the modern workplace on Onfra.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">1. <strong>Engage with Employees to Shape the Future</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To effectively shape a supportive and sustainable workplace, businesses must prioritize employee feedback and engagement. Integrating touchless technology to facilitate daily interactions not only reduces physical contact but also boosts safety and efficiency. Companies should explore various <a href="https://www.culturemonkey.io/employee-engagement/employee-feedback-tools/">employee feedback tools</a>, including those that support anonymous inputs to ensure genuine responses.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Create a Flexible and Adaptable Workplace</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Flexibility in the workplace goes beyond remote working; it extends to how physical spaces are utilized and managed. Implementing a <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/smart-moves-for-a-modernization-5-approaches-to-transform-with-the-smart-visitor-management-software/">touchless check-in and check-out system</a> enhances the flexibility of entering and leaving the office without physical contact, making daily operations smoother and more hygienic. This integration supports a seamless transition between different work settings, fostering a dynamic and adaptive environment.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Future-Proof Your Organization Through Technology</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Adopting cutting-edge technologies, including touchless systems, is crucial for sustainable business growth. These systems not only streamline operations but also gather data to optimize workspace usage and support hybrid work models. Forward-thinking companies will benefit from robust IT infrastructure that supports such technologies, enhancing their capacity to adapt to future challenges.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Detailed Discussion on Each Strategy</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>In-Depth Look at Employee Engagement</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Enhancing employee engagement with touchless technologies can significantly impact workplace culture and efficiency. Leadership must take an active role in promoting these technologies, ensuring they align with the company’s values and employees’ needs. Read more about leadership's role in technology integration on our <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/blog/">blog</a>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Designing Workspaces That Adapt to Change</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The design of workspaces should accommodate touchless technologies to promote a safe and efficient environment. Modern office designs can include features that support touchless operations, such as automated doors and lights, which complement the touchless check-in systems. Discover how ergonomic designs enhance workspace efficiency on Onfra’s solutions page.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Leveraging Technology for Sustainable Growth</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Integrating cloud computing and ensuring robust cybersecurity are crucial when adopting new technologies like touchless systems. These measures protect data and ensure the seamless operation of technological solutions across various platforms. Learn about implementing secure and effective technology solutions at Onfra.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Implementation of Strategies</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Steps to Implement Employee Feedback Mechanisms</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Employing touchless feedback mechanisms can enhance the collection and utilization of employee feedback, facilitating real-time improvements and adjustments. Companies can set up touchless feedback kiosks or utilize apps that support feedback without physical interaction. For more details on setting up these systems, visit our <a href="https://howto.onfra.io/">implementation guide</a>.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Transitioning to a Flexible Workplace Model</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A phased approach to introducing touchless technologies ensures a smooth transition. Effective communication strategies are essential to manage employee expectations and maintain productivity. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Upgrading Technology Systems</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Choosing the right technology partners is crucial for a successful implementation of touchless systems. Training programs tailored to these technologies are necessary to minimize disruptions and maximize benefits.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>FAQs</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>How do touchless check-in and check-out systems improve workplace efficiency?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>These systems streamline entry and exit processes, reduce wait times, and minimize physical contact, enhancing overall workplace efficiency.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What are the best practices for redesigning office spaces with touchless technology?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Incorporating touchless technologies should focus on maximizing space utilization and enhancing employee comfort and safety.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>How should companies approach remote work policies with new technologies?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Remote work policies should be flexible and include provisions for technology support to ensure employees can work efficiently from any location.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>What role does management play in implementing touchless systems?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Management should lead by example, advocating for and facilitating the use of touchless systems within the workplace.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Can small businesses afford touchless technology solutions?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Yes, there are scalable touchless solutions available that can be customized to fit the needs and budgets of small businesses.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>How do you measure the success of touchless systems implementation?</strong></h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Success can be measured by improved operational efficiency, reduced physical contact points, and positive feedback from employees.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Conclusion</strong></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As businesses strive to adapt to the changing landscape of work, investing in touchless technologies ensures they remain competitive, safe, and efficient. The future of work will increasingly rely on innovations that enhance operational efficiencies and employee satisfaction. For further insights into preparing your business for the future, explore our <a href="https://onfra.io/">resources</a>.</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[10 Interesting Workplace Facts That You Didn’t Know]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/10-interesting-workplace-facts-that-you-didnt-know/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 02 May 2024 17:47:42 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2881</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Discover 12 fascinating facts about the <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/unlocking-workplace-efficiency-with-ai-tools-and-prompts-for-facility-management-success/">workplace </a>that will surprise you and change the way you think about work.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>People spend a lot of time at work every week, so it's worth paying attention to how it's changing. Since 2020, many companies started letting employees work remotely, partly at home, or with flexible schedules. This means both bosses and workers are dealing with new ways of doing things.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Balance between work and personal life is becoming more important to everyone, no matter their job. After the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic">pandemic</a>, people are focusing more on their well-being and <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/ensure-safety-and-implement-a-healthy-workplace/">mental health</a>, and businesses are thinking more about how to keep going in a sustainable way.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Let's look at some interesting and fun facts about work productivity, working from home, and the latest workplace trends in 2024. We'll also check out some psychological facts about how work affects our minds.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>1. The average worker spends over 90,000 hours working over their lifetime, so finding job and workplace satisfaction matters </h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Workers spend a lot of time working – more than 90,000 hours in their lifetime!</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>According to a big consulting company called McKinsey &amp; Company, the average person spends about 90,000 hours working throughout their life. That's a huge chunk of time! So, it's not surprising that whether we like our jobs or not can have a big impact on our lives.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>So, how can we be happy and satisfied with our work? Annie McKee, who wrote a book called "How to Be Happy at Work: The Power of Purpose, Hope, and Friendship," has been studying this. She says there's a kind of formula for it:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Career happiness = (Freedom + Challenge + Balance – Stress) x Meaning</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Sarah Archer, a career coach, agrees with McKee's formula. She says, "Employers are starting to realize that happy employees are better at their jobs. But more importantly, we're seeing for ourselves how our work affects our mental health."</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>2. Dress code and workplace productivity are not mutually exclusive: 61% of employees are more productive when the dress code is more casual</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Businesses started allowing casual dress on Fridays in 2018 because research indicated that employees work better when they feel comfortable. This trend continued, especially during the pandemic when working from home became common. But now, with different work models, some companies struggle to find the right balance between what employees want and what the company stands for.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>During the pandemic, the line between casual and business casual became blurred. While wearing pajamas might have been okay during video calls before, it's not acceptable anymore, whether working remotely, in a hybrid setup, or at the office. Reintroducing a business casual dress code benefits both employers and employees.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Workplace specialist and attorney Rudi Julius emphasizes the importance of companies adapting to hybrid work while ensuring that employees maintain a clean, neat, and professional appearance that aligns with the company's image and is acceptable to clients.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>3. Video conferencing and video meetings are here to stay: Video calls on Microsoft Teams have increased 1000% since the pandemic</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Video meetings using tools like Microsoft Teams have become a big part of how we work, especially since the pandemic. There's been a huge increase in their use, with video calls on Teams going up by 1000%. These tools help us connect with colleagues from all over the world without needing to travel.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Microsoft Teams, for example, has over 280 million users. It lets us chat online, share files, and use all the usual office tools we need. This makes it much easier to collaborate, even if we're not in the same place.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Because of this, more and more organizations are using video meetings and conferences. They're a great way to work together and build relationships. With features like chat, file sharing, and calendar integration, it's no wonder they've become so popular.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>4. Activity-based working boosts employee workplace satisfaction and productivity</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Activity-Based Working (ABW) is a way of working where employees can use different spaces and technologies for different tasks, like meetings, chats, or focused work.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With hybrid and flexible work, ABW lets companies have shared workspaces instead of each person having their own desk. This works as long as there's a system to book desks, rooms, and other spaces.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Research by Veldhoen + Company shows that switching to ABW can make employees happier at work, with a 17% increase in satisfaction. It also boosts productivity, with individuals being 13% more productive and teams being 8% more productive.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>5. Hybrid work models are used by most high-growth companies in 2024</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Most people don't want to go back to working full-time in an office. Only 2 out of 10 employees who can work remotely are still working completely in the office. And it's likely to stay that way, with just 6% wanting to return to the office full-time in the future.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Hybrid work, which means a mix of working from home and the office, is becoming more common. Around 63% of rapidly growing companies are sticking with this model. So, it looks like hybrid work is going to be around for a while.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Not listening to what workers want about hybrid work could cause problems. When people can't work where they prefer, they're less engaged in their job. They also feel more stressed and want to quit more often. It's important for them to feel comfortable in their work environment so they can do their best work and live a happier life.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>6. The impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) on jobs is expected to be a net positive over the next 4 years</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A recent study by the IMF in 2024 found that AI could affect nearly 40% of jobs worldwide. Robots and automated tasks are becoming more common at work. They handle repetitive and simple jobs, giving employees more time for important tasks. Examples include chatbots, language models like ChatGPT, and systems that help automate processes, such as robotic processing assistants (RPA).</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Even though robots and AI are increasingly important, human interaction remains crucial at work. Humans possess unique abilities like critical thinking and emotions that machines can't replicate. While there's been a long-standing worry about machines replacing humans since the 1800s, humans have always found ways to stay relevant. Most AI and robots still need human input, interaction, and maintenance to function effectively.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>According to Eric Dahlin, a sociology professor at BYU, new technologies are often adopted without considering the real-world challenges like cultural differences, economic factors, and government regulations. His research shows that only a small percentage of workers have seen their jobs replaced by AI. Additionally, the World Economic Forum predicts that AI will create more jobs than it replaces over the next four years.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The World Economic Forum's 2023 report highlights that advancements like agriculture technologies, digital platforms, e-commerce, digital trade, and AI will disrupt the job market. While some jobs may be lost, many new ones will be created, resulting in a net increase in employment opportunities.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>7. Remote working continues to trend in the US: 12% of workers are fully remote, and 28% are hybrid</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Every month, economists from Stanford University and the University of Chicago survey 10,000 American workers to learn about their jobs. This survey, called the Survey of Working Arrangements and Attitudes, started in 2020.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The latest study focused on how many people work from home. It discovered that more people work from home in big cities than in smaller ones. Also, there are fewer jobs where people can work fully from home than what employees want.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The study found that remote work is more common in certain industries like technology, finance, and professional services. It also found that workers spend more time on training when they work in an office, which is interesting information from the Economic Forum's report in 2023.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>8. Email volume: 347.3 billion emails are sent each day across the globe – with more on the way</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>More emails are being sent every day. In 2022, about 333.2 billion emails were sent daily. It's predicted that next year, this number will grow to 376 billion, which is around a 13% increase.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>On average, a worker receives about 121 emails each day and sends out about 40. Emails can sometimes feel overwhelming. Are they really helping us work better, or are they just causing interruptions?</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Research from UC Berkeley shows that we're interrupted at work every 8 minutes. With interruptions happening so often, it's no surprise that many of us are trying to find new ways to be more productive.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>9. 76% of employees who currently work hybrid want to continue with this model</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Many people like hybrid work because it helps them balance work and personal life better. Our study found that less time spent commuting and being able to manage home life were the top benefits. 7 out of 10 workers think companies that offer hybrid work care about their needs. Giving the option for hybrid work makes employees feel more valued for their mental and emotional health. 69% of office workers, whether they work from home, have a hybrid schedule, or are in the office all the time, agree that hybrid work shows employers care about their well-being and productivity. This goes up to 76% for those who already have hybrid schedules. The numbers show that employees really want to keep the hybrid model.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>10. 45% of US employees see going to the office as a means to improve relationships with colleagues, clients, and vendors</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>We asked 6,000 leaders and employees worldwide about their thoughts on the workplace. In the US, here's what caught our eye:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>45% view the office as a place to meet colleagues, clients, and vendors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>36% believe being in the office improves company culture.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>35% rely on the office for a productive and well-equipped environment.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>32% think going to the office helps with work-life balance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Human connection is crucial. The office is essential for fostering company culture, mainly because it allows people to connect with each other. Without people interacting, there wouldn't be a workplace culture at all.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

		<title><![CDATA[Breaking It Down: Get To Know Our Award-Winning Visitor Management System]]></title>

		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today's rapidly evolving world, visitor management systems (VMS) have become indispensable tools for businesses and organizations across various industries. Among the plethora of options available in the market, Onfra stands out as an Award-Winning Visitor Management System, offering unparalleled features, security, and convenience. Let's delve into the world of Onfra and explore how it revolutionizes the way we manage visitors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">The Significance of Visitor Management Systems</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Visitor management plays a crucial role in enhancing security, streamlining operations, and creating a positive experience for guests. Traditional paper-based logbooks are no longer sufficient in ensuring the safety of premises and personnel. With Onfra, organizations can leverage cutting-edge biometric technologies to authenticate visitors, track their movements, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, all in real-time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Exploring Onfra's Features</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra The Award-Winning Visitor Management Systemboasts a comprehensive suite of features designed to meet the diverse needs of modern businesses:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Face Recognition and Liveness Detection</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Utilizing advanced facial recognition algorithms, Onfra accurately identifies visitors and verifies their identity in real-time. Liveness detection ensures that the visitor is physically present, guarding against spoofing attacks and unauthorized access.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Face Matching and Photo ID Matching</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra facilitates one-to-one face matching and photo ID matching, enabling seamless verification of visitors against pre-registered profiles. This ensures that only authorized individuals gain access to restricted areas, enhancing overall security.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Face Search and Age Verification</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>With Onfra's face search capabilities, security personnel can quickly locate individuals of interest within a large database, aiding in investigations and threat mitigation. Additionally, age verification functionalities enable businesses to enforce age-restricted policies with ease, such as alcohol sales or entry to certain venues.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">On-Premise Solution and Iris Recognition</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra offers both cloud-based and on-premise deployment options to cater to the unique requirements and preferences of each organization. Additionally, iris recognition technology provides an additional layer of security, as iris patterns are highly unique and difficult to replicate.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">AML (Anti-Money Laundering)</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In compliance with regulatory standards, Onfra incorporates robust anti-money laundering (AML) features, helping businesses prevent financial crimes and adhere to strict compliance mandates. By screening visitors against watchlists and conducting enhanced due diligence, Onfra mitigates the risk of illicit activities on premises.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Practical Applications of Onfra</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The applications of Onfra are vast and varied, spanning across industries which make it an Award-Winning Visitor Management System, such as:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/the-sureshot-ways-to-impress-your-office-visitors/">Corporate Offices</a>: Enhancing access control and security for employees, visitors, and contractors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/visitor-management-for-the-pharmaceutical-industry/">Healthcare Facilities</a>: Ensuring patient confidentiality and regulating access to sensitive areas.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Educational Institutions: Managing campus visitors, improving campus safety, and tracking attendance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/perks-of-visitor-management-with-government-ids-scanning/">Government Buildings</a>: Strengthening border security, managing public access, and facilitating secure interactions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Technical Capabilities and Integration</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a> excels in terms of technical capabilities, boasting high accuracy rates, scalability to accommodate large volumes of visitors, and seamless integration with existing systems such as access control and visitor databases. Its intuitive interface and customizable workflows make it easy to deploy and manage, even for organizations with complex requirements.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Future Trends in Visitor Management</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As technology continues to advance, we can expect <a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a> to evolve accordingly, incorporating emerging trends such as:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Mobile Integration: Seamless visitor registration and check-in via mobile devices, enhancing convenience for both visitors and staff.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Artificial Intelligence: Further enhancing facial recognition capabilities through AI-driven algorithms, improving accuracy and reliability.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Contactless Solutions: Minimizing physical touchpoints and interactions through contactless authentication methods, in line with post-pandemic safety protocols.</li>

By harnessing the power of biometric technologies such as face recognition, Onfra empowers organizations to safeguard their premises, protect their assets, and deliver exceptional visitor experiences. As we look towards the future, Onfra remains at the forefront of innovation, continuously raising the bar for visitor management excellence.</p>

					<item>
		<title><![CDATA[The Ultimate Guide: Setting Up Your Visitor Management System Like a Pro]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/step-by-step-guide-to-setup-visitor-management-system/</link>
		<pubDate>Thu, 02 May 2024 17:10:54 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2886</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In the contemporary landscape of security and access control, A setup Visitor Management System  is paramount. A VMS streamlines the process of<a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/elevate-security-through-visitor-photo-capture-with-reception-sign/"> registering</a>, tracking, and managing visitors within a facility,<a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/elevate-security-through-visitor-photo-capture-with-reception-sign/"> ensuring security</a>, <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/reasons-why-staffing-agencies-need-a-vm-system-now/">efficiency</a>, and compliance. So this article will guide you through the essential steps of setting up a Visitor Management System, outlining key considerations and best practices.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>Introduction</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A Visitor Management System serves as the frontline defense for controlling access to a premise. It encompasses a range of technologies and processes designed to authenticate, monitor, and manage visitors effectively. So by implementing a VMS, organizations can enhance security measures, streamline visitor registration processes, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>Exploration of the Topics</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4>Understanding the Components</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A comprehensive Visitor Management System comprises several key components, including:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Visitor Registration</strong>: Visitors are required to provide necessary information such as name, contact details, purpose of visit, and identification documents. </li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Check-in/Check-out Process</strong>: Upon arrival, visitors check in at the designated kiosk or reception area. A digital record is created, capturing relevant details and timestamps. Similarly, visitors check out upon departure, ensuring accurate tracking of their duration within the premises.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Identity Verification</strong>: Biometric technologies such as face recognition or fingerprint scanning may be integrated to verify the identity of visitors, enhancing security and preventing unauthorized access.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Access Control Integration</strong>: Because Integration with access control systems enables seamless management of visitor access permissions. Authorized visitors are granted access to designated areas based on predefined rules and criteria.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4>Practical Applications</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The practical applications of a Visitor Management System extend across various industries and settings:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Corporate Offices</strong>: VMS enhances security by accurately monitoring and controlling visitor access. It also facilitates the pre-registration of guests, expediting the check-in process.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Healthcare Facilities</strong>: In healthcare settings, VMS ensures compliance with HIPAA regulations by securely managing visitor information. It also helps in controlling access to sensitive areas such as patient rooms and laboratories.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Educational Institutions</strong>: Schools and universities utilize VMS to monitor visitor traffic, enhance campus security, and ensure the safety of students and staff.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>Integration and Implementation</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4>Steps to Setup Visitor Management System:</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list {"ordered":true} -->
<ol><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Assess Requirements</strong>: Identify the specific needs and objectives of your organization regarding visitor management.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Select a VMS Provider</strong>: Research and choose a reputable VMS provider that offers features aligned with your requirements.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Customization and Configuration</strong>: Work with the provider to customize the VMS according to your organizational policies and workflows.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Installation and Training</strong>: Deploy the VMS across relevant access points and provide training to staff members responsible for managing visitor registration and monitoring.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Testing and Optimization</strong>: Conduct thorough testing to ensure the VMS functions as intended. Make necessary adjustments and optimizations based on feedback and performance evaluations.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ol>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>Future Trends</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The future of Visitor Management Systems is marked by advancements in biometric authentication, artificial intelligence, and cloud-based solutions. Emerging trends include:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Mobile Visitor Management</strong>: Integration with mobile devices for seamless visitor registration and access control.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>AI-powered Analytics</strong>: Utilization of AI algorithms to analyze visitor data and identify patterns for enhanced security and operational efficiency.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>Conclusion</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, It is crucial to  <a href="https://youtu.be/yGwIqj1bNCI?feature=shared">Setup Visitor Management System</a> as it is strategic and is best investment for organizations. Seeking to bolster security measures, streamline visitor management processes, and ensure regulatory compliance. Because understanding the components, practical applications, technical details, and best practices outlined in this article, you can embark on the journey of implementing an effective VMS like <a href="https://onfra.io/">Visitdesk </a>tailored to your organization's needs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>TOP FAQs:</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>1. What is a Visitor Management System (VMS), and why is it essential?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> A <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/how-to-master-the-art-of-visitor-management/">Visitor Management System</a> is a software solution that facilitates the registration, tracking and management of visitors within a facility. It is essential for enhancing security, streamlining visitor registration processes, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>2. What are the key components of a Visitor Management System?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> The key components of a <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/discover-remarkable-secrets-behind-digital-receptionist-systems/">Visitor Management System</a> include visitor registration, check-in/check-out processes, identity verification (such as biometric authentication), access control integration, and reporting/analytics functionalities.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>3. How do I choose the right Visitor Management System for my organization?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> When <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/choosing-the-right-office-visitor-management-system-a-comprehensive-guide/">selecting a Visitor Management System</a>, consider factors such as your organization's specific needs and objectives, scalability of the system, integration capabilities with existing security systems, data security measures, user-friendliness, and customer support provided by the vendor.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>4. Can a Visitor Management System be customized to align with our organization's policies and workflows?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> Yes, most<a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/visitor-management-challenges-affordable-solutions-for-small-businesses-in-india/"> Visitor Management Systems </a>offer customization options to tailor the system according to your organization's policies, workflows, and branding requirements. Work closely with the vendor to ensure that the system meets your specific needs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>5. What are the steps involved in setting up a Visitor Management System?</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> The steps typically involved in setting up a Visitor Management System include assessing your requirements, selecting a<a href="https://onfra.io/"> reputable VMS provider</a>, customizing and configuring the system, installing the software/hardware components, providing training to staff members, conducting testing and optimization, and ongoing monitoring and maintenance.</p>

		<title><![CDATA[Next-Level Security: QR Codes Pave the Way for Touchless Access]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/qr-codes-pave-the-way-for-touchless-access/</link>
		<pubDate>Fri, 03 May 2024 07:16:13 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2922</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In an era where hygiene and safety are paramount concerns, touchless technologies have gained significant traction across various industries. One such technology that has emerged as a powerful tool for streamlining processes while <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/enhancing-womens-safety-at-work-places/">ensuring safety</a> is the QR code. QR codes, or Quick Response codes, have transformed the way businesses manage visitor entry and exit, offering a seamless and contactless experience. Let's delve into how QR codes enable touchless visitor management and why they are becoming increasingly popular.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">The Significance of Touchless Visitor Management</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Touchless visitor management systems have become essential for organizations looking to prioritize safety and <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/elevate-your-workspace-with-15-modern-office-furniture-pieces/">efficiency</a>. Traditional methods of visitor registration, such as sign-in sheets or manual registration processes, often involve physical contact with shared surfaces, increasing the risk of germ transmission. In contrast, touchless systems, powered by QR codes, eliminate the need for physical interaction, offering a safer and more hygienic alternative.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How QR Codes Facilitate Touchless Visitor Management</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>QR codes serve as digital identifiers that contain information readable by smartphones or dedicated scanning devices. When implemented in visitor management systems, QR codes enable a contactless check-in and check-out process. Here's how it works:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">1. Generation of QR Codes:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Upon scheduling a visit or appointment, visitors receive a unique QR code via email or mobile app. This QR code serves as their digital pass and contains relevant information such as the visit date, time, and purpose.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">2. Scanning Process:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>At the entry point, visitors present their QR codes to a designated scanning device or staff member equipped with a smartphone. The QR code is swiftly scanned, capturing the visitor's information and registering their entry into the premises.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">3. Seamless Experience:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The entire process is quick and seamless, requiring minimal effort from both visitors and staff. There's no need for physical contact or lengthy registration procedures, enhancing convenience and efficiency.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Benefits of QR Code-Based Visitor Management</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>The adoption of QR code-based visitor management systems offers a myriad of benefits for organizations:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Enhanced Safety:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>By eliminating physical contact and reducing shared touchpoints, QR code-based systems contribute to a safer and more hygienic environment, mitigating the risk of germ transmission.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Streamlined Processes:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>QR codes expedite the check-in and check-out process, reducing wait times and minimizing disruptions. This streamlined approach enhances operational efficiency and improves the overall visitor experience.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Data Accuracy:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Digital visitor records generated through QR code scans are more accurate and reliable than manual entries. Organizations can access detailed insights into visitor traffic, facilitating better resource allocation and decision-making.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Contact Tracing:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In the event of an emergency or health-related incident, QR code-based systems simplify contact tracing efforts. Organizations can quickly identify and notify individuals who may have been exposed to potential risks, enhancing safety protocols.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Integration and Implementation</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>One of the key advantages of QR code-based visitor management systems is their ease of integration and implementation. These systems can be seamlessly integrated with existing access control and security infrastructure, minimizing disruption to operations. VMS platforms like <a href="https://onfra.io/">Onfra</a> are compatible with a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, and dedicated scanning terminals, ensuring flexibility and scalability.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Real-World Applications</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>QR code-based visitor management systems have found applications across various industries, including:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong><a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/revolutionizing-the-modern-offices-with-tech-innovations/">Corporate Offices</a></strong>: Streamlining visitor registration and access control.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Healthcare Facilities</strong>: Managing patient appointments and visitor restrictions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Educational Institutions</strong>: Tracking visitor traffic and enhancing campus security.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Events and Conferences</strong>: Facilitating attendee check-in and monitoring event attendance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Future Trends and Innovations</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>As technology continues to evolve, QR code-based visitor management systems are likely to undergo further advancements. Future trends may include:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Enhanced Security Features</strong>: Integration with biometric authentication for added security.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Personalized Experiences</strong>: Customized QR codes for VIP guests or recurring visitors.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li><strong>Internet of Things (IoT) Integration</strong>: Seamless connectivity with IoT devices for automated access control.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In conclusion, QR codes have emerged as a versatile and efficient solution for <a href="https://youtu.be/gD3iXdf9aEE?feature=shared">touchless visitor management</a>. By leveraging QR code technology, organizations can enhance safety, streamline processes, and improve overall operational efficiency. As the adoption of touchless technologies continues to rise, QR code-based visitor management systems are set to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of access control and security.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>

		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>In today’s rapidly evolving world, ensuring the <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/reasons-why-staffing-agencies-need-a-vm-system-now/">security and efficiency</a> of visitor management processes is paramount for businesses of all sizes. One of the most effective ways to achieve this is by Download A Visitor Management System, which leverages cutting-edge biometric technologies to streamline check-in processes, enhance security, and improve overall visitor experience. In this guide, we'll explore the steps involved in downloading and setting up a VMS to optimize your organization's visitor management procedures.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Understanding the Significance of a Visitor Management System</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Before delving into understanding the process to Download A Visitor Management System, it's crucial to grasp the importance of such a system in <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/smart-moves-for-a-modernization-5-approaches-to-transform-with-the-smart-visitor-management-software/">modern-day settings</a>. A VMS serves as a comprehensive solution for managing visitors, contractors, and employees entering and exiting a facility. By utilizing biometric technologies such as face recognition, liveness detection, and photo ID matching, VMS ensures accurate identification and authentication of individuals, thereby bolstering security measures and minimizing potential risks.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Exploring the Core Features of a Visitor Management System</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>A robust VMS typically encompasses various features designed to streamline visitor registration, check-in, and monitoring processes. Some key functionalities include:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>1. Streamlined Registration Process:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Visitors can pre-register online, providing necessary information and documents in advance.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Integration with government databases for real-time <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/welcome-to-visitdesk-one-stop-solution-for-all-vms-requirements/">identity verification</a>.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>2. Efficient Check-In Procedures:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Self-service kiosks equipped with biometric authentication for quick and secure check-ins.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Instant badge printing with visitor details and access permissions.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>3. Enhanced Security Measures:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Face matching technology for verifying visitors against their photo IDs.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Liveness detection to prevent fraudulent attempts using static images.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3>4. Comprehensive Reporting and Monitoring:</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Real-time monitoring of visitor movements within the premises.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Detailed analytics and reporting functionalities for compliance and audit purposes.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Steps to Download and Set Up a Visitor Management System</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Now, let's walk through the process of downloading and setting up a VMS:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 1: Research and Select a Suitable VMS Provider</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Conduct thorough research to identify <a href="https://onfra.io/">reputable VMS</a> providers that offer features aligned with your organization's needs.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Consider factors such as scalability, customization options, and customer support.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 2: Register and Create an Account</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Visit the website of your chosen VMS provider and navigate to the registration or sign-up page.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Provide necessary details to create an account, such as company information and contact details.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 3: Choose Subscription Plan and Download Software</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Select a subscription plan that best fits your organization's requirements and budget.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Once subscribed, proceed to download the VMS software from the provider's website.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 4: Install and Configure the VMS Software</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Follow the installation instructions provided by the VMS provider to install the software on your designated devices.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Configure the settings according to your preferences, including user permissions, access levels, and integration with existing systems.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 5: Test and Train Staff</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Conduct thorough testing to ensure the VMS functions smoothly and effectively.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Train relevant staff members on how to use the VMS, including registration, check-in procedures, and troubleshooting common issues.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":3} -->
<h3> 6: Roll Out the VMS Across Facilities</h3>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:list -->
<ul><!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Once satisfied with the setup and testing, deploy the VMS across all relevant facilities within your organization.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item -->

<!-- wp:list-item -->
<li>Monitor its performance closely during the initial rollout phase and make necessary adjustments as needed.</li>
<!-- /wp:list-item --></ul>
<!-- /wp:list -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2>Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Implementing a Visitor Management System equipped with advanced biometric technologies is instrumental in enhancing security, streamlining visitor management processes, and ensuring regulatory compliance. By following the steps outlined in this guide, organizations can download, set up, and effectively leverage a <a href="https://youtu.be/gD3iXdf9aEE?feature=shared">VMS to optimize</a> their visitor management procedures and safeguard their premises.</p>

		<title><![CDATA[Why visitor access control can’t be ignored right now]]></title>
		<link>https://onfra.io/blogs/why-visitor-access-control-cant-be-ignored-right-now/</link>
		<pubDate>Sun, 05 May 2024 03:38:11 +0000</pubDate>
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[visitdesk_editor]]></dc:creator>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://visitdesk.io/?p=2937</guid>
		<description></description>
		<content:encoded><![CDATA[<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Visitor access control is crucial for protecting assets, ensuring compliance, safeguarding personnel safety, and maintaining operational efficiency.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Unlocking the Potential of Building Access Control Systems</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Recent innovations in <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/why-is-visitor-management-important/">visitor management system</a> (VMS) technology and their integration with access control systems (ACS) bring peace of mind to organizations hosting guests. VMS <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/delving-into-the-advantages-of-cloud-based-visitor-management-systems/">cloud-based</a> integrations improve core business processes, making it easy for companies to enhance performance and uphold health responsibilities. Access control integrations alone provide significant benefits, making VMS a popular choice for <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/designing-your-home-office-post-covid-19/">COVID-19</a> facing companies.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><em>The next level: Access control integrations with visitor management systems</em></h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>When you combine the visitor management system with the access control system, it improves safety and security for everyone in the building. This also makes the check-in process better for visitors.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>To show this, let's look at the benefits when organizations use <a href="https://onfra.io/blogs/">Onfra </a>with their access control system:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Onfra 's visitor management solution is easy to connect with the access control system. It can work with any additional entry processes that are needed, using standard hardware.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>This means that if any changes are needed for the access control system, they are easy to find, design, and install without being limited to one manufacturer.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>What's even better is that Onfra partners with many top system providers to offer a complete solution for any organization's access security needs.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p><em>On that note, some of the main features that come from those access control integrations include:</em></p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">1. Synchronized visitor data with access control-</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>When visitor profiles are set up beforehand, integrated visitor management systems can quickly identify, welcome, and assist visitors upon their arrival.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Administrative staff don't have to manually input visitor information. Instead, visitor data is automatically transferred from the visitor management system to the access control system when visits are scheduled. This saves time and avoids the hassle of entering visitor details twice.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading {"level":4} -->
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">2. Convenient QR access-</h4>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Convenient QR access makes it easy for visitors to enter the building. Before they arrive, they receive unique QR codes via email. They can scan these codes when they get here. Plus, we can control when they have access and for how long.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Applying access control integrations against COVID-19</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Even with just a few advantages of access control integrations we’ve detailed above, it’s not too hard to see how these features might be used by organizations to keep people healthy and prevent the spread of COVID-19.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Here are some of the common ways they are making a difference today:</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">1. Limiting person-to-person contact</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>COVID-19 usually spreads when people are too close, so it's crucial to avoid big gatherings during this pandemic.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Using destination dispatch helps companies prevent big crowds near multiple elevators and control how people move to different floors. Designate one person to clean keypads, touch screens, or cards to reduce touching surfaces.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">2. Maintaining comprehensive activity and incident logs</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>It can take up to two weeks for someone sick with COVID-19 to start showing symptoms. They can still spread the virus during this time.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>When someone tests positive, it's important to quickly notify anyone they recently came in contact with.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>These tools help organizations keep detailed records of everyone near an infected person. By tracking when people entered and left, we can find out exactly when and where they might have been exposed.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>VMS alerts make it easy to tell everyone who might be at risk.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">In Conclusion</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->

<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Visitor access control is imperative for security and compliance. Ignoring it poses risks of breaches, non-compliance penalties, and health hazards like during COVID-19. It protects data, ensures liability accountability, and boosts efficiency with automation. Prioritizing it is essential for safeguarding assets and maintaining safety.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->]]></content:encoded>
